title: Desenvolvedor Salesforce Pleno
description:

O profissional atuará no contexto de Sustentação , sendo responsável por analisar necessidades do negócio, definição de soluções, correções de erros e conduzir melhorias sistêmicas na plataforma.

  • Participação na definição de soluções técnicas.
  • Apoio técnico a desenvolvedores juniores.

  • Experiência consolidada em projetos Salesforce (Sales, Service, Experience Cloud).
  • Forte domínio de Apex, LWC e SOQL.
  • Experiência com integrações complexas.
  • Conhecimento de governança e limites da plataforma.

  • Profissional engajado e colaborativo

title: Desenvolvedor Python

Confira esta oportunidade para Desenvolvedor Python em camaçari. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

Come to one of the biggest IT Services companies in the world!! Here you can transform your career!


Why to join TCS? Here at TCS we believe that people make the difference, that's why we live a culture of unlimited learning full of opportunities for improvement and mutual development. The ideal scenario to expand ideas through the right tools, contributing to our success in a collaborative environment.


We are looking for a Senior Python Developer, who wants to learn and transform his career.


In this role you will

Backend & APIs

  • Support the creation of dashboards and reports to assess strategic effectiveness.
  • Ensure data quality, consistency, and governance.


Mandatory Skills

  • +5 years of experience
  • Backend: Solid experience with Python (FastAPI, Flask, or Django).
  • Data: Experience with relational modeling, ETL/ELT pipelines, and advanced SQL.
  • AI: Experience integrating LLMs and agent frameworks (LangChain, LangGraph, AutoGen).
  • Architecture: Familiarity with REST API design and software best practices.
  • Infrastructure: Experience with PostgreSQL.
  • Language: Technical English for reading documentation.


Desirable Skills

  • Domain Knowledge: Experience in the electric power sector, free energy market, or trading.
  • Orchestration: Experience with Prefect, Airflow, or Temporal.
  • Vector Databases: Experience with Pinecone, Weaviate, or pgvector.
  • Observability: Experience monitoring applications and APIs (logs, metrics, tracing).
  • Community: Contributions to open‑source AI or Data projects.

title: Senior Technical Consultant – Front Arena
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Senior Technical Consultant – Front Arena em lauro de freitas. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

Why Zensar?

We’re a bunch of hardworking, fun-loving, people-oriented technology enthusiasts. We love what we do, and we’re passionate about helping our clients thrive in an increasingly complex digital world. Zensar is an organization focused on building relationships with our clients and with each other—and happiness is at the core of everything we do. In fact, we’re so into happiness that we’ve created a Global Happiness Council, and we send out a Happiness Survey to our employees each year. We’ve learned that employee happiness requires more than a competitive paycheck, and our employee value proposition—grow, own, achieve, learn (GOAL)—lays out the core opportunities we seek to foster for every employee. Teamwork and collaboration are critical to Zensar’s mission and success, and our teams work on a diverse and challenging mix of technologies across a broad industry spectrum. These industries include banking and financial services, high-tech and manufacturing, healthcare, insurance, retail, and consumer services. Our employees enjoy flexible work arrangements and a competitive benefits package, including medical, dental, vision, 401(k), among other benefits. If you are looking for a place to have an immediate impact, to grow and contribute, where we work hard, play hard, and support each other, consider joining team Zensar!


Zensar is looking for a Senior Technical Consultant – Front Arena .


About the Role

The Senior Technical Consultant will act as the technical SME for the Front Arena implementation, responsible for overall technical design, integrations, and enabling delivery teams during both scoping and execution phases.


Key Responsibilities

Lead technical design for the Front Arena or Murex (MX.3B) or Calypso (Nasdaq) technical configuration (static data, environments) implementation

Own technical architecture, integrations, and system configuration approach

Support scoping activities, including defining technical complexity and risks

Act as technical SME to guide and upskill junior and partner consultants

Work closely with functional leads to ensure coherent front to back solutions

Support on site workshops as required


Required Skills & Experience

Spanish nice to have

Strong Front Arena technical expertise (configuration, architecture, integrations) or Murex (MX.3B) or Calypso (Nasdaq) technical configuration (static data, environments)

Experience with full front to back Front Arena implementations

Prior involvement in large scale / greenfield implementations

Ability to mentor and guide junior technical resources

Experience working in multi vendor delivery models

Spanish language skills strongly preferred

Experience in Latin American / Mexican market environments is a strong advantage,

Competent with Python


Zensar believes that diversity of backgrounds, thought, experience, and expertise fosters the robust exchange of ideas that enables the highest quality collaboration and work product. title: Leadership trainer
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Leadership trainer em camaçari. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

About NIIT


NIIT provides comprehensive and scalable managed training services for learning administration that maps directly to our customer needs. Training is our business and passion. We are one of the largest training outsourcing providers in the world. NIIT delivers and administers 75,000 days of training each year, in 18 languages. We have designed and developed over 50,000 days of classroom training and 20,000 hours of web-based training localized to more than 25 languages. NIIT is a global service provider. We have a presence in more than 40 countries.



Link to our LinkedIn Page -

Link to our website -


Position: Leadership Trainer

Job Type - Freelance


Are you passionate about developing leaders and helping individuals excel in their careers? Do you possess a deep understanding of leadership theories, career development strategies, and practical techniques? If so, we have an exciting opportunity for you!


NIIT is a leading provider of professional development solutions, and we are seeking a highly skilled and experienced Leadership Skills Trainer to join our dynamic team. In this role, you will have the opportunity to make a significant impact by designing and delivering innovative training programs that empower individuals to reach their full leadership potential and accelerate their careers.


Responsibilities & Key Skills:


  • Deliver high-quality leadership skills training programs for professionals at various levels, from entry-level to executives.
  • Facilitate engaging and interactive training sessions using a variety of instructional techniques, including experiential learning, case studies, role-plays, and group exercises.
  • Creative Problem Solving
  • Agile Ways of Working
  • Influencing Skills for Leading Without Authority
  • Managerial and Leadership Skills
  • Leading team performance
  • Leading change


Qualifications:


  • Bachelor's degree in a relevant field (e.g., Business, Psychology, Organizational Development).
  • Proven experience as a Leadership Skills Trainer, Career Coach, or related role, with a focus on leadership development and career advancement.
  • Strong knowledge of leadership theories, models, and best practices.
  • Excellent facilitation and presentation skills, with the ability to engage and inspire diverse audiences.
  • Ability to build rapport and establish credibility with individuals at all levels of an organization.
  • Strong coaching and mentoring skills, with the ability to provide constructive feedback and support individual growth.
  • Exceptional communication skills, both verbal and written.
  • Proactive, self-motivated, and able to work independently as well as part of a team.
  • Certification in leadership development, coaching, or related areas (e.g., CPLP, ICF, CTDP) is a plus.
  • 10+ years’ experience preferred
  • Language Requirements: Bilingual in local language (If Applicable) & English


If you are a dynamic and results-driven professional who thrives on helping others succeed, we would love to hear from you. Join our team and contribute to the growth and development of individuals and organizations through impactful leadership skills programs


NIIT is an equal opportunity employer. We evaluate qualified applicants without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability, veteran status, or any other protected characteristic

title: Director of Engineering
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Director of Engineering em feira de santana. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

Director of Engineering (LATAM Based) - Remote - $175K Base


About the Company:


We are partnering with a fast-growing SaaS platform modernizing complex operational workflows for institutional financial services organizations. Their technology helps enterprise clients streamline onboarding, transaction management, compliance workflows, and stakeholder collaboration through a secure cloud-based platform.


The product is used by sophisticated organizations that require reliability, scalability, and high standards for security and operational excellence. They are focused on reducing operational friction and delivering a seamless digital experience in an industry traditionally dependent on manual processes.


The Opportunity:


We are seeking an experienced Director of Engineering to lead and scale a distributed engineering organization in a high-growth remote environment.


This role will oversee multiple engineering teams and front-line engineering managers across a globally distributed organization. The ideal candidate is a strong people leader who excels at building engineering culture, improving operational maturity, and helping teams execute effectively at scale.


You will work closely with executive leadership, product management, and architecture leadership to drive engineering execution, organizational development, and technical excellence.


What You’ll Do:


  • Lead and mentor engineering managers and technical leaders across multiple teams
  • Build a strong engineering culture centered on accountability, collaboration, quality, and continuous improvement
  • Scale engineering operations through effective hiring, onboarding, organizational planning, and career development
  • Improve engineering processes, delivery predictability, and development workflows across teams
  • Partner with Product and cross-functional leadership to align technical execution with business priorities
  • Establish engineering best practices around architecture, testing, CI/CD, observability, and platform reliability
  • Support organizational growth by developing future leaders and strengthening management capabilities
  • Drive alignment and communication across distributed engineering teams operating in multiple time zones
  • Help create a high-performing, inclusive, and transparent remote-first environment


Qualifications:


  • 8+ years of software engineering experience with significant engineering leadership responsibility
  • Proven experience managing managers and overseeing multiple engineering teams in a scaling organization
  • Strong background in Agile delivery, DevOps practices, CI/CD, and modern software engineering operations
  • Experience scaling distributed engineering organizations in remote or hybrid environments
  • Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills
  • Ability to balance technical quality, delivery execution, and organizational health
  • Strong technical foundation with the ability to guide architectural and engineering decisions
  • Experience partnering closely with Product and executive leadership


Compensation & Benefits:

  • Base salary: $175,000 USD
  • Fully remote - company HQ'd in the US
  • Opportunity to help shape engineering strategy during a high-growth phase

title: Assistente de Suporte Técnico de TI
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Assistente de Suporte Técnico de TI em salvador. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

Descrição da Vaga

Atuar na linha de frente do suporte, sendo o ponto focal para nossos usuários internos. O objetivo é garantir a continuidade dos negócios, assegurando que o ambiente de trabalho (físico e lógico) esteja sempre disponível e produtivo. Você será o guardião da experiência do usuário, tratando cada chamado com o senso de urgência e a qualidade que nossos clientes internos exigem.

Principais Responsabilidades

1. Operação e Atendimento (Sustentação)

  • Gestão de Chamados: Atuar no atendimento via sistemas de gestão (GLPI, Jira), respeitando rigorosamente os níveis de serviço (SLAs) e prazos de resolução.
  • Multicanalidade: Prestar suporte técnico ágil e eficiente através de diferentes vias: presencial, telefone, vídeo conferência e chats.
  • Manutenção de Hardware: Executar instalação, desinstalação, configuração e formatação de estações de trabalho (desktops/notebooks).
  • Manutenção Preventiva: Realizar a limpeza física e verificação de periféricos, incluindo impressoras e acessórios, garantindo a longevidade dos equipamentos e evitando falhas.

2. Infraestrutura e Software

  • Software: Instalação, atualização e suporte a softwares, com foco em Pacote Office 365 e sistemas legados/ERP (TOTVS).
  • Redes: Diagnóstico e suporte básico de conectividade (rede local, Wi-Fi e VPN).
  • Gestão de Inventário: Organizar e controlar o estoque de ativos (TI), garantindo a integridade dos equipamentos e auxiliando na gestão eficiente de recursos.

Requisitos Técnicos

  • Formação: Ensino Técnico em TI completo ou cursando/graduado em áreas correlatas (Sistemas de Informação, Redes, Ciência da Computação).
  • Domínio Técnico:
  • Experiência com ferramentas de chamados (GLPI, Jira).
  • Conhecimento prático em ERP (TOTVS) e ecossistema Microsoft (Windows/Office 365).
  • Vivência em montagem, configuração e manutenção física/lógica de computadores.
  • Noções básicas de redes (TCP/IP, impressoras, DNS).

Perfil Comportamental

  • Senso de Urgência & Organização: Entender que o tempo do usuário parado é um custo para a empresa; capacidade de priorizar demandas críticas.
  • Olhar de Dono: Zelo pelo patrimônio, cuidado com o estoque e proatividade para sugerir melhorias contínuas.
  • Comunicação Assertiva: Excelente escrita e fluência verbal para atendimento ao cliente.
  • Empatia: Capacidade de ouvir, compreender a frustração do usuário e prestar um atendimento humano e prestativo.

title: Customer Success Specialist
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Customer Success Specialist em lauro de freitas. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

JoVE is the world- leading producer and provider of video solutions with the mission to improve scientific research and education. Millions of scientists, educators and students use JoVE for their research, teaching and learning. Our institutional clients comprise over 1,000 universities, colleges, and biopharma companies, including such leaders as Harvard, MIT, Yale and Stanford. As a rapidly growing company, with offices in the USA, UK, Australia, and India servicing clients in over 60 countries, we are seeking talented and ambitious individuals to join our company.


The Role


As a Customer Success Specialist, you will help professors at leading universities in the US integrate JoVE videos into their courses to improve teaching outcomes and student success. You'll play a key role in ensuring users get the most value from their JoVE subscription.



Please share your resume in English.



Responsibilities:


  • Conduct daily outreach to Faculty (via calls, emails, and 1:1 demos) to set up JoVE integrations in courses and increase product usage.
  • Increase JoVE adoption by delivering product awareness sessions across existing customer universities and research institutes.
  • Grow engagement and usage by delivering presentations at (1) exhibits and conferences, (2) university seminars and workshops, and (3) onsite customer visits.
  • Strengthen subscription renewal outcomes by ensuring smooth implementation support, and consistent usage of JoVE resources.
  • Influence product decisions by communicating customer feedback to sales, product, and marketing teams.


Requirements:


  • A master's degree or PhD in Life Science disciplines.
  • Experience in science communications, academic outreach or other customer-facing roles is preferred.
  • Fluent communication skills English.
  • Knowledge of education, market trends, and challenges in assigned content areas i.e. Biology, Chemistry, Medicine, Physics, Engineering, or Psychology.
  • Strong interpersonal skills with a passion for remote relationship-building.
  • Experience in networking using cold calling is preferred.


Why Join JoVE?


  • You can expect compensation packages competitively placed within the local market.
  • You will make a direct impact in accelerating science research and in improving student learning in science education.
  • Opportunity to work with global teams and in an environment that promotes innovation and collaboration.
  • Our strong promotion from within culture draws a clear path to advance your career with us.

title: Senior Oil & Gas Regulatory & Severance Tax Accountant
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Senior Oil & Gas Regulatory & Severance Tax Accountant em salvador. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

Location: Brazil (100% Remote)

Experience Level: Mid to Senior (5+ years)

Industry: Oil & Gas (Unconventional Onshore)


Role Summary

We are seeking a highly analytical Senior Regulatory & Severance Tax Accountant to join our integrated Revenue team. The primary focus of this role is to ensure the integrity of severance tax reporting for Texas and Louisiana operations. You will be responsible for identifying, troubleshooting, and resolving reporting discrepancies that lead to state-issued penalties. This is a technical, hands-on role requiring deep experience in SAP PRA (CA/VL modules) and the ability to bridge the gap between transactional data and state regulatory compliance.


Responsibilities

  • Severance Tax Compliance : Lead the end-to-end severance tax reporting process for Texas and Louisiana, ensuring all volumes and values are reported accurately and timely to the respective state agencies.
  • Error Detection & Troubleshooting : Proactively identify reporting errors by comparing state-level data against internal production and valuation records. Utilize the Valuation Control Report (VCR) and specific SAP T-Codes to diagnose root causes of variances.
  • PPA Analysis : Analyze Prior Period Adjustments (PPAs) before posting to understand the ripple effect on the General Ledger (GL), production volumes, and pricing. Ensure all adjustments are justified and accurately reflected in amended filings.
  • Penalty Reduction : Serve as the lead in reducing state-issued penalties through meticulous data validation and the timely filing of amended returns (e.g., Texas G-10/P-5, Louisiana O3).
  • Process Improvement : Troubleshoot systemic process failures and, as needed, document standardized workflows to serve as guides for broader transactional teams.
  • Cross-Functional Collaboration : Work as one team with the Revenue Accounting group to ensure that valuation formulas and owner payment setups are consistent with regulatory requirements.



Requirements

  • Minimum of 2 years of hands-on experience in the Check Input (CA) and Valuation (VL) modules. Must have experience booking company-operated revenues and navigating sub-ledger details.
  • At least 5+ years of experience, including experience in Upstream Oil & Gas accounting, ideally focused on unconventional, onshore assets.
  • Proven experience with US (ideally Texas and Louisiana )severance tax regulations, including high-cost gas exemptions and state disposition reporting.
  • Ability to perform deep-dive reconciliations across production, revenue, and tax data sets to identify complex transactional errors.
  • Advanced/Fluent English (written and spoken) is required for coordination with US-based stakeholders.
  • A diagnostic mindset - able to look at a reporting error and trace the logic back through the SAP PRA system to the source data.
  • Capable of managing complex reporting deadlines and independent research in a fully remote environment.


Technical Requirements

  • ERP: SAP PRA (CA, VL modules), S/4HANA (preferred).
  • Reporting Tools: Advanced Excel (Power Query/Pivot), Power BI, VCR Analysis.

title: Director of Engineering
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Director of Engineering em lauro de freitas. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

Director of Engineering (LATAM Based) - Remote - $175K Base


About the Company:


We are partnering with a fast-growing SaaS platform modernizing complex operational workflows for institutional financial services organizations. Their technology helps enterprise clients streamline onboarding, transaction management, compliance workflows, and stakeholder collaboration through a secure cloud-based platform.


The product is used by sophisticated organizations that require reliability, scalability, and high standards for security and operational excellence. They are focused on reducing operational friction and delivering a seamless digital experience in an industry traditionally dependent on manual processes.


The Opportunity:


We are seeking an experienced Director of Engineering to lead and scale a distributed engineering organization in a high-growth remote environment.


This role will oversee multiple engineering teams and front-line engineering managers across a globally distributed organization. The ideal candidate is a strong people leader who excels at building engineering culture, improving operational maturity, and helping teams execute effectively at scale.


You will work closely with executive leadership, product management, and architecture leadership to drive engineering execution, organizational development, and technical excellence.


What You’ll Do:


  • Lead and mentor engineering managers and technical leaders across multiple teams
  • Build a strong engineering culture centered on accountability, collaboration, quality, and continuous improvement
  • Scale engineering operations through effective hiring, onboarding, organizational planning, and career development
  • Improve engineering processes, delivery predictability, and development workflows across teams
  • Partner with Product and cross-functional leadership to align technical execution with business priorities
  • Establish engineering best practices around architecture, testing, CI/CD, observability, and platform reliability
  • Support organizational growth by developing future leaders and strengthening management capabilities
  • Drive alignment and communication across distributed engineering teams operating in multiple time zones
  • Help create a high-performing, inclusive, and transparent remote-first environment


Qualifications:


  • 8+ years of software engineering experience with significant engineering leadership responsibility
  • Proven experience managing managers and overseeing multiple engineering teams in a scaling organization
  • Strong background in Agile delivery, DevOps practices, CI/CD, and modern software engineering operations
  • Experience scaling distributed engineering organizations in remote or hybrid environments
  • Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills
  • Ability to balance technical quality, delivery execution, and organizational health
  • Strong technical foundation with the ability to guide architectural and engineering decisions
  • Experience partnering closely with Product and executive leadership


Compensation & Benefits:

  • Base salary: $175,000 USD
  • Fully remote - company HQ'd in the US
  • Opportunity to help shape engineering strategy during a high-growth phase

title: Talent Acquisition Lead LATAM
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Talent Acquisition Lead LATAM em camaçari. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

Talent Acquisition Lead LATAM


About the role

AI/R Company is a global ecosystem of technology and innovation that brings together companies specialized in digital transformation, software engineering, data, cloud, and artificial intelligence. The group includes well-known companies in the market such as Avenue Code and Compass UOL, working on strategic projects for major organizations worldwide.


With a strong international presence, AI/R Company connects talent and technology to accelerate digital transformation for its clients, fostering a collaborative, multicultural environment focused on continuous innovation.

We are looking for a Talent Acquisition Lead LATAM to lead recruitment strategies for technical positions across different countries in Latin America. This person will be responsible for driving strategic hiring processes, supporting regional leadership in team expansion, and ensuring excellence in both candidate and internal stakeholder experience.


We are seeking a hands-on professional with strong experience in international technical recruiting within IT consulting, strategic mindset, leadership capabilities, and a results-driven approach.

This role will have constant interaction with global stakeholders, technology leaders, and business areas, making strong communication skills, prioritization, and the ability to thrive in dynamic, multicultural environments essential.


Key responsibilities

  • Lead the LATAM Talent Acquisition team, fostering development, performance tracking, and best recruiting practices
  • Drive attraction and selection strategies for technical roles across various seniority levels and technologies
  • Actively manage international recruitment processes across Latin America and/or North America
  • Align hiring strategies with technology leaders, operations, and executive leadership
  • Ensure agility, quality, and predictability in recruitment processes
  • Conduct market mapping and develop sourcing strategies for highly specialized profiles
  • Monitor recruitment metrics and continuously improve funnel performance, SLA, conversion rates, and candidate experience
  • Structure and optimize recruitment processes, policies, and tools
  • Participate in global meetings and collaborate with international teams


Required qualifications

  • Strong experience in Talent Acquisition with a focus on technical recruiting
  • Previous experience in IT consulting or outsourcing companies
  • Proven experience leading recruitment teams
  • Strong background in international hiring, especially across LATAM
  • Experience recruiting roles such as Software Engineers, QA, DevOps, Data, Cloud, SAP, among others
  • Advanced or fluent English for interviews and meetings
  • Experience with active sourcing and talent attraction strategies
  • Analytical, organized, and metrics-driven profile


Nice to have

  • Intermediate or advanced Spanish
  • Experience with LATAM operations expansion
  • Experience in multicultural and high-volume environments
  • Knowledge of ATS systems, recruitment metrics, and TA automation
  • Experience working with global clients in the U.S. or Canada



Avenue Code reinforces its commitment to privacy and compliance with the most rigorous data protection regulations worldwide, such as GDPR, LGPD, CCPA, and CPRA. Candidates’ data will be kept confidential and used exclusively for recruitment purposes and may be shared with clients and companies within the Compass UOL Group involved in projects.

title: Liquidity Partnership Manager (LATAM)
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Liquidity Partnership Manager (LATAM) em salvador. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

Role Overview

We are looking for an LP Partnership Manager to drive business development and build strong relationships with liquidity providers across key regions. This role will be instrumental in sourcing, onboarding, and managing LP partners, while working closely with the trading team to optimize liquidity, pricing, and execution.

The ideal candidate is highly connected within the local market, with a strong network of liquidity providers and a deep understanding of regional payment and banking landscapes.


Key Responsibilities

Business Development & Partnerships

  • Identify, source, and establish relationships with local and regional liquidity providers
  • Evaluate LP quality (pricing, depth, reliability, regions covered)
  • Negotiate trading terms (spreads, fees, credit lines, margin terms)


Market & Network Development

  • Leverage existing network to expand LP coverage in key regions (APAC, LATAM, Africa)
  • Maintain strong relationships with banks, payment providers, and liquidity partners
  • Stay up to date with local market dynamics, pricing trends, and competitive landscape


Execution & Collaboration

  • Work closely with traders to ensure optimal liquidity, pricing, and execution quality
  • Coordinate with internal teams to onboard LPs and ensure smooth operational setup
  • Support ongoing performance monitoring and optimization of LP relationships


Banking & Infrastructure Setup

  • Facilitate opening of bank accounts and payment rails required for LP operations
  • Identify suitable partners to support local currency flows and settlement


Requirements

  • 5 to 10 years of experience in business development, partnerships, or liquidity management
  • Strong experience in payments, FX, trading, or related financial services
  • Well connected with liquidity providers, banks, and payment partners
  • Proven ability to source and onboard LPs in local markets
  • Strong understanding of regional market structures and liquidity dynamics
  • Must have strong, deep LP network in at least one of the following regions: LATAM


Vision & Mission

  • OSL is the first SFC-licensed digital asset platform in Hong Kong and a PayFi innovator. Through stablecoin payments, cross-border settlement and global licensing, we are building the next-generation payments network. Stablecoins have become everyday money across emerging markets and are widely viewed as blockchain’s “killer app,” with industry focus shifting from token issuance to real-world consumer and enterprise payment adoption. The strongest growth lies in cross-border B2B payments, where providers embedding stablecoins into corporate settlement flows can capture significant volume and float. Long-term defensibility comes from regulatory licences, banking partners and cross-border corridors.
  • OSL holds or has acquired licences in Hong Kong, Japan, Australia, Bermuda and Indonesia, and is expanding into Europe, Brazil, Southeast Asia and Africa through acquisitions and licence applications. With OSL Pay and StableX, we embed stablecoin settlement into bank accounts and card networks, support 150+ digital assets, and provide 24/7 fiat–stablecoin conversion. As a regulated pioneer with a startup mindset, we believe the future of payments will be driven by real adoption and scalable deployment, not technology narratives. We welcome builders who are passionate about crypto and payments to join us in shaping compliant, global payment infrastructure.

title: Senior Oil & Gas Regulatory & Severance Tax Accountant
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Senior Oil & Gas Regulatory & Severance Tax Accountant em camaçari. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

Location: Brazil (100% Remote)

Experience Level: Mid to Senior (5+ years)

Industry: Oil & Gas (Unconventional Onshore)


Role Summary

We are seeking a highly analytical Senior Regulatory & Severance Tax Accountant to join our integrated Revenue team. The primary focus of this role is to ensure the integrity of severance tax reporting for Texas and Louisiana operations. You will be responsible for identifying, troubleshooting, and resolving reporting discrepancies that lead to state-issued penalties. This is a technical, hands-on role requiring deep experience in SAP PRA (CA/VL modules) and the ability to bridge the gap between transactional data and state regulatory compliance.


Responsibilities

  • Severance Tax Compliance : Lead the end-to-end severance tax reporting process for Texas and Louisiana, ensuring all volumes and values are reported accurately and timely to the respective state agencies.
  • Error Detection & Troubleshooting : Proactively identify reporting errors by comparing state-level data against internal production and valuation records. Utilize the Valuation Control Report (VCR) and specific SAP T-Codes to diagnose root causes of variances.
  • PPA Analysis : Analyze Prior Period Adjustments (PPAs) before posting to understand the ripple effect on the General Ledger (GL), production volumes, and pricing. Ensure all adjustments are justified and accurately reflected in amended filings.
  • Penalty Reduction : Serve as the lead in reducing state-issued penalties through meticulous data validation and the timely filing of amended returns (e.g., Texas G-10/P-5, Louisiana O3).
  • Process Improvement : Troubleshoot systemic process failures and, as needed, document standardized workflows to serve as guides for broader transactional teams.
  • Cross-Functional Collaboration : Work as one team with the Revenue Accounting group to ensure that valuation formulas and owner payment setups are consistent with regulatory requirements.



Requirements

  • Minimum of 2 years of hands-on experience in the Check Input (CA) and Valuation (VL) modules. Must have experience booking company-operated revenues and navigating sub-ledger details.
  • At least 5+ years of experience, including experience in Upstream Oil & Gas accounting, ideally focused on unconventional, onshore assets.
  • Proven experience with US (ideally Texas and Louisiana )severance tax regulations, including high-cost gas exemptions and state disposition reporting.
  • Ability to perform deep-dive reconciliations across production, revenue, and tax data sets to identify complex transactional errors.
  • Advanced/Fluent English (written and spoken) is required for coordination with US-based stakeholders.
  • A diagnostic mindset - able to look at a reporting error and trace the logic back through the SAP PRA system to the source data.
  • Capable of managing complex reporting deadlines and independent research in a fully remote environment.


Technical Requirements

  • ERP: SAP PRA (CA, VL modules), S/4HANA (preferred).
  • Reporting Tools: Advanced Excel (Power Query/Pivot), Power BI, VCR Analysis.

description:

Company:


Windsor.ai has been founded in 2017 in Zürich, , we are growing fast. We connect data from 300+ sources (Facebook Ads, Google Ads, HubSpot, Salesforce, TikTok) to 30+ destinations (Looker Studio, Google Sheets, BigQuery, Snowflake, and LLMs like ChatGPT and Claude). Our customers include Puma, Audi, UBS, Asics and many more.


We are building a platform that makes it easy to connect any data source to any destination. There is more data being generated in the world every day, but the big problem is that the number of tools is also increasing so data must be updated in multiple systems and tools. We are solving this problem.


Role: We are looking for a Senior Python Engineer to join our team, focusing on Python services, API integrations, scalability, and production reliability.


Our Team:


Our team has around 30 people working remotely across Europe. We’re a highly technical team, and even our sales and marketing colleagues are comfortable writing at least some SQL. Our software engineers are specialised in backend with Python and frontend with React


Product:


We have built a data platform connecting to more than 300 different API’s. Big part of our work is dealing with all the complexity and variations in all the different API’s and scalability.


Technology:


We are mostly programming in python and using quite advanced features of python. Most common tools we use:


  • Python : flask, threads, pytest-xdist, pylint
  • Redis, postgres
  • Linux, docker
  • React, redux for frontend

  • 4+ years of programming experience.
  • Strong expertise in Python, with experience building and maintaining complex, production-grade systems
  • Good programming knowledge (OOP, mutable/immutable types etc.)
  • Solid experience working in Linux-based development and production environments
  • Enjoy working in a fast-moving organization where you can have a real impact
  • Fluency in English is mandatory


How we work:


We usually plan our work in two weeks intervals but the plan is not super strict so there might be some priorities changed during the sprint. We use Taiga, Gitlab, CI/CD lots of pytest and merge request reviews.


Location: Remote


Windsor.ai is a global team of data engineers and analysts who strive to make data integration effortless and insights easy to extract to everyone. We help businesses of all sizes connect their marketing and sales data, automate reporting, and measure what drives the greatest impact.

Qualifications:


  • 8+ years of software engineering experience with significant engineering leadership responsibility

  • Strong background in Agile delivery, DevOps practices, CI/CD, and modern software engineering operations
  • Experience scaling distributed engineering organizations in remote or hybrid environments
  • Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills
  • Ability to balance technical quality, delivery execution, and organizational health
  • Strong technical foundation with the ability to guide architectural and engineering decisions
  • Experience partnering closely with Product and executive leadership


Compensation & Benefits:

  • Base salary: $175,000 USD

Gestor(a) de Contas – Marketplace & Performance

Somos uma empresa especializada em estratégia, operação e crescimento de e-commerces e marketplaces , com forte atuação orientada a dados, tecnologia e performance .

Buscamos um(a) Gestor(a) de Contas para atuar de forma estratégica, sendo responsável pela operação e pelos resultados dos clientes .

Essa posição exige visão analítica, senso de dono e capacidade de integrar estoque, tráfego, campanhas e performance comercial em diferentes marketplaces.


Responsabilidades

  • Atuar como responsável direto(a) pela performance dos clientes, sendo o ponto focal da conta
  • Monitorar e garantir SLA dos marketplaces, antecipando riscos e oportunidades
  • Acompanhar estoque no Centro de Distribuição e realizar solicitações de abastecimento para venda direta
  • Definir e acompanhar a estratégia de venda entre marketplaces (onde vender, quando e como)
  • Gerenciar campanhas ativas, mix de produtos e visibilidade nos marketplaces
  • Analisar dados de tráfego, estoque e conversão, propondo ações contínuas de crescimento
  • Atuar de forma próxima a clientes e lideranças, com comunicação clara, estratégica e orientada a resultados
  • Evoluir, em até 6 meses, para autonomia total na gestão da performance, regras de tráfego e decisões de estoque


Requisitos

  • Experiência com marketplaces e e-commerce, especialmente em gestão operacional e performance
  • Excel intermediário
  • Forte senso de dono, responsabilidade e visão de negócio
  • Facilidade para trabalhar com dados, indicadores e métricas
  • Afinidade com tecnologia e ferramentas digitais
  • Capacidade de navegação e análise em painéis de marketplace (ex.: Mercado Livre)
  • Boa comunicação para interação com clientes e lideranças


Diferenciais

  • Vivência com gestão de múltiplas contas ou operações simultâneas
  • Perfil analítico, investigativo e orientado à melhoria contínua
  • Experiência em ambientes dinâmicos e com alta exigência por resultados


O que oferecemos

  • Salário compatível com o mercado
  • Remuneração variável trimestral , vinculada ao alcance de metas e resultados
  • Ambiente dinâmico, com autonomia e impacto direto no negócio


Modelo de trabalho

  • 100% remoto (Home Office)
  • Disponibilidade para atuação presencial no Centro de Distribuição no litoral de São Paulo , quando necessário.

title: Desenvolvedor
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Desenvolvedor em camaçari. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

Desenvolvedor(a) .NET + Python + AWS


Modalidade: remoto

Tipo de Contrato: CLT


Responsabilidades:

- Desenvolver, testar e manter aplicações em .NET e Python, garantindo a eficiência e escalabilidade dos sistemas.

- Projetar e implementar soluções em nuvem utilizando AWS, incluindo serviços como EC2, S3, Lambda, RDS e outros.

- Colaborar com equipes multidisciplinares para entender requisitos de negócios e traduzir em soluções técnicas eficazes.

- Participar na definição de arquiteturas de sistemas e na escolha de tecnologias apropriadas para os projetos.

- Implementar práticas de DevOps, incluindo CI/CD, automação de testes e monitoramento de aplicações.

- Contribuir para a melhoria contínua dos processos de desenvolvimento e da qualidade do código.


Requisitos:

- Experiência sólida em desenvolvimento de aplicações com .NET (C# ou VB.NET).

- Proficiência em Python e suas bibliotecas comuns.

- Conhecimento prático de serviços AWS e arquiteturas de nuvem.

- Familiaridade com bancos de dados relacionais e não relacionais (SQL, NoSQL).

- Experiência em metodologias ágeis (Scrum, Kanban, etc.).

- Habilidade em trabalhar em equipe e excelentes habilidades de comunicação.


Diferenciais:

- Certificações em AWS ou outras tecnologias relevantes.

- Experiência em contêineres (Docker, Kubernetes).

- Conhecimento em práticas de segurança na nuvem.

title: Engenheiro de software
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Engenheiro de software em lauro de freitas. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

A PSM Company é especializada na identificação de Talentos para as áreas de TI / Telecom como também para as áreas operacionais e administrativas. Nossa história de sucesso, está baseada em nosso modelo de negócios que proporcionam assertividade e qualidade no processo seletivo, baixo Turn Over e isenção de riscos e passivos trabalhistas.


O que Buscamos?


Engenheiro de software


Descrição:


-Projetar, implementar e entregar funcionalidades complexas em componentes grandes ou aplicações de médio porte do design ao deploy;

-Experiência sólida com React/TypeScript no frontend, e Python/FastAPI no backend;

-Experiência com Azure Database, Microsoft Fabric, Power BI, PostgreSQL e modelagem de dados relacional;

-Atuação com pgvector ou bancos vetoriais;

-Forte Domínio prático com Clean Code, SOLID, YAGNI, TDD, BDD e 12-Factor App;

-Experiência com Microsoft Azure, GitHub Actions, Claude Code e práticas de CI/CD;

-Experiência com Segurança e governança: Microsoft Entra ID, Azure Key Vault e Microsoft Purview;

-Proficiência em uma ampla gama de design patterns e estruturas de dados;

-Experiência com observabilidade (logs, métricas e tracing);

- Escrever código limpo, seguro, estável e testável que qualquer engenheiro do time consiga entender e resolver problemas técnicos difíceis com soluções pragmáticas;

-Testar código com rigor: testes unitários, de integração e de contrato (não são etapas separadas);

- Documentar o software com clareza: decisões arquiteturais, intenções de design e contratos entre componentes;


Diferencial:

-Conhecimento em integração de APIs de IA (Claude API, OpenAI) e construção de features com LLMs;

-Familiaridade com Azure API Management, Azure Event Grid ou event-driven architecture;

-Experiência com compliance (LGPD);

-Vivência em ambientes de alto crescimento ou startups com times enxutos e alta cadência de entrega;

-Contribuições em projetos open source ou portfólio técnico público;


Atuação Home Office

Contratação CLT


O que oferecemos?

Vale Refeição ou Alimentação;

Assistência Médica e Assistência Odontológica;

Auxílio creche;

Convênio com Farmácia;

Parcerias com Universidades e Escolas de Idiomas;

Parceria de descontos com Seguro Auto e Residência;

WellHub;

Seguro de Vida;



Promovemos um ambiente de trabalho inclusivo e acolhedor. Não fazemos distinção por raça, cor, religião, gênero, orientação sexual, nacionalidade, deficiência ou idade. Todas as candidaturas serão consideradas. O seu interesse em participar deste processo seletivo, automaticamente consente, autoriza e concorda que a PSM COMPANY, no papel de CONTROLADORA, tome decisões referentes ao tratamento de seus dados pessoais para esta finalidade específica, em conformidade com a Lei nº 13.709 – Lei Geral de Proteção de Dados Pessoais (LGPD).

title: Assistente administrativo
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Assistente administrativo em lauro de freitas. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

Descrição do Cargo Estamos buscando um Assistente Administrativo dedicado para atuar em nossa equipe remotamente. Este cargo envolve o suporte às atividades administrativas diárias, incluindo a gestão e organização de documentos e suporte a processos administrativos internos e contatos da empresa.


Este é um cargo de tempo integral e requer atuação remota.


Qualificações

  • Assistência Administrativa: Experiência em suporte administrativo geral, incluindo gestão e organização de documentos, contatos e arquivos.
  • Etiqueta Telefônica e Comunicação: Competência em realizar atendimentos com profissionalismo e clara habilidade de comunicação verbal e escrita.
  • Assistência Executiva: Conhecimento em suporte a executivos, coordenação de agendas e gerenciamento de tarefas administrativas.
  • Dentre os diferenciais, consideramos um bom conhecimento em softwares de gestão empresarial e um perfil organizado e proativo.

title: Specialist Cloud Architect (AWS)
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Specialist Cloud Architect (AWS) em lauro de freitas. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

Descrição da vaga

Buscamos uma pessoa Cloud Architect Especialista para atuar em um time estratégico de alta maturidade técnica, com foco em modernização de aplicações, infraestrutura em nuvem AWS e práticas avançadas de DevOps.

Esse profissional será referência técnica, apoiando decisões arquiteturais complexas, definindo padrões, garantindo governança e assegurando a adoção das melhores práticas do AWS Well-Architected Framework em soluções de missão crítica.


Responsabilidades e atribuições

  • Apoiar clientes na adoção de soluções de modernização de aplicações e infraestrutura em nuvem AWS;
  • Atuar como referência técnica no desenho, validação e evolução de arquiteturas em nuvem escaláveis, seguras, resilientes e eficientes;
  • Desenvolver soluções, modelos de referência, frameworks e ferramentas para a plataforma AWS;
  • Provisionar, configurar e gerenciar infraestrutura em AWS, garantindo padrões de segurança, performance e custo;
  • Definir e implementar pipelines de automação utilizando Infrastructure as Code (IaC) com Terraform, AWS CloudFormation e AWS CDK (Python);
  • Estruturar, evoluir e otimizar pipelines de CI/CD para deploy de aplicações, agentes e ferramentas;
  • Garantir conformidade das soluções com o AWS Well-Architected Framework;
  • Atuar no levantamento de requisitos técnicos e não técnicos, apoiando decisões estratégicas de arquitetura;
  • Definir e disseminar boas práticas de arquitetura, infraestrutura, segurança, governança e observabilidade;
  • Promover compartilhamento de conhecimento, mentoria técnica e apoio à evolução do time.


Requisitos e qualificações obrigatórios


  • Ensino superior completo;
  • Mínimo de 2 anos de atuação comprovada em CTPS;
  • Experiência sólida e aprofundada com AWS;
  • Experiência sólida com AWS CDK (Python), AWS CloudFormation e Terraform;
  • Experiência em levantamento de requisitos, definição e desenho arquitetural, provisionamento, configuração e desenvolvimento de recursos AWS;
  • Experiência na estruturação e evolução de esteiras CI/CD, containers, Git, boas práticas DevOps e padrões de segurança;
  • Excelente capacidade de comunicação técnica para interação com públicos técnicos e não técnicos.


Habilidades comportamentais

  • Comunicação clara, estratégica e assertiva;
  • Capacidade de conduzir discussões técnicas complexas e negociações arquiteturais;
  • Visão sistêmica e pensamento estratégico;
  • Perfil de referência técnica, com atuação consultiva e de mentoria;
  • Proatividade, autonomia e senso de responsabilidade;
  • Forte orientação à qualidade, eficiência e resultados;
  • Capacidade de tomada de decisão em ambientes complexos.



Sobre a empresa


Become a Compasser, be part of AI/R.

Compass UOL is a global firm and part of the AI Revolution Company, together transforming organizations using Artificial Intelligence, Generative AI, and other of today’s most advanced technologies.

We equip our team with proprietary and external AI-driven tools to design and build digital-native platforms, integrating cutting-edge technologies and enabling companies to innovate, transform their businesses, and drive success in their markets.

To achieve this, we attract and develop the best talent, creating opportunities that enhance people’s lives and highlight the positive impact of disruptive technologies.

We empower borderless talent and promote knowledge and opportunities in the latest market trends, driving significant personal and professional growth.

title: Cloud Analyst
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Cloud Analyst em camaçari. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

A Foursys é um time apaixonado por inovação, design e transformação digital.

Somos globais, somos GPTW.


♿️ Na Foursys, celebramos a diversidade e acreditamos que são as diferentes ideias e perspectivas que nos enriquecem. Portanto, sua cor, religião, gênero, raça, nacionalidade, idade, origem, identidade de gênero, deficiência ou orientação sexual não são barreiras para se juntar à nossa equipe. #VemSerFoursys!


Todas as nossas vagas estão abertas para Pessoas com Deficiência (PCD). Caso você se enquadre ou conheça alguém com o perfil, a Foursys é a empresa ideal!


Que tal se juntar a nós e se tornar um(a) #FourTalent? Então se liga nessa oportunidade incrível:


Responsabilidades e Atividades

• Realizar análise de custos em ambiente Cloud Azure.

• Atuar na gestão e alocação de custos Cloud.

• Criar previsões, tendências e planejamento financeiro relacionados ao consumo Cloud.

• Apoiar times de Engenharia, Projetos e Produtos na gestão financeira de recursos Azure.

• Atuar com governança e compliance financeiro em nuvem.

• Criar dashboards, relatórios e visualizações de dados para acompanhamento financeiro.

• Realizar análises detalhadas por serviço, região, produto, equipe ou centro de custo, mantendo rotinas contínuas de monitoramento de custos.

• Estruturar e manter modelos de rateio, garantindo associação correta de custos via tags, grupos de recursos e estruturas financeiras.

• Revisar taxonomias e sugerir melhorias de governança.

• Participar de reuniões de revisão de custos Azure com times de operações e liderança.

• Participar de comitês FinOps, governança e gestão orçamentária.

• Mapear oportunidades de savings para construção de planos financeiros anuais.

• Criar previsões de uso e gastos utilizando dados históricos, identificando tendências e sazonalidade de consumo.

• Avaliar impacto financeiro de novos projetos ou workloads e apoiar análises de ROI de iniciativas Cloud.

• Garantir aderência às políticas de tagging e governança de recursos.

• Construir dashboards, alertas e indicadores automatizados para acompanhamento técnico e financeiro.


Requisitos obrigatórios:

Conhecimento intermediário a avançado em Microsoft Azure, incluindo infraestrutura, serviços e tecnologias da plataforma.

• Experiência com Governança em Azure, contemplando:

  • Azure Cost Management
  • Azure Advisor
  • Azure Reservations
  • Azure Policies

• Conhecimento em estruturas de gerenciamento de recursos e organização de ambientes em nuvem:

  • Management Groups
  • Accounts/Subscriptions
  • Billing Groups

• Vivência em práticas de FinOps, incluindo:

  • Princípios da FinOps Foundation
  • Modelos de Showback e Chargeback
  • Alocação e rateio de custos em nuvem
  • Controle orçamentário e elaboração de forecast
  • Análise de custos por unidade de negócio, produto ou centro de custo
  • Interpretação de relatórios financeiros e operacionais

• Conhecimento em políticas de tagging, padronização e taxonomia Cloud.

• Experiência na criação de dashboards, relatórios gerenciais e visualização de dados.

• Certificações Microsoft Azure e/ou FinOps serão consideradas diferenciais.

Engenheiro de software

-Projetar, implementar e entregar funcionalidades complexas em componentes grandes ou aplicações de médio porte do design ao deploy;

WellHub;

Seguro de Vida;

Esse profissional será referência técnica, apoiando decisões arquiteturais complexas, definindo padrões, garantindo governança e assegurando a adoção das melhores práticas do AWS Well-Architected Framework em soluções de missão crítica.


Responsabilidades e atribuições

  • Apoiar clientes na adoção de soluções de modernização de aplicações e infraestrutura em nuvem AWS;
  • Atuar como referência técnica no desenho, validação e evolução de arquiteturas em nuvem escaláveis, seguras, resilientes e eficientes;
  • Desenvolver soluções, modelos de referência, frameworks e ferramentas para a plataforma AWS;
  • Provisionar, configurar e gerenciar infraestrutura em AWS, garantindo padrões de segurança, performance e custo;
  • Definir e implementar pipelines de automação utilizando Infrastructure as Code (IaC) com Terraform, AWS CloudFormation e AWS CDK (Python);
  • Estruturar, evoluir e otimizar pipelines de CI/CD para deploy de aplicações, agentes e ferramentas;

Responsabilidades e Atividades

• Realizar análise de custos em ambiente Cloud Azure.

• Atuar na gestão e alocação de custos Cloud.

• Criar previsões, tendências e planejamento financeiro relacionados ao consumo Cloud.

• Apoiar times de Engenharia, Projetos e Produtos na gestão financeira de recursos Azure.

• Atuar com governança e compliance financeiro em nuvem.

• Criar dashboards, relatórios e visualizações de dados para acompanhamento financeiro.

• Realizar análises detalhadas por serviço, região, produto, equipe ou centro de custo, mantendo rotinas contínuas de monitoramento de custos.

• Estruturar e manter modelos de rateio, garantindo associação correta de custos via tags, grupos de recursos e estruturas financeiras.

• Revisar taxonomias e sugerir melhorias de governança.

• Participar de reuniões de revisão de custos Azure com times de operações e liderança.

• Participar de comitês FinOps, governança e gestão orçamentária.

• Mapear oportunidades de savings para construção de planos financeiros anuais.

• Criar previsões de uso e gastos utilizando dados históricos, identificando tendências e sazonalidade de consumo.

• Avaliar impacto financeiro de novos projetos ou workloads e apoiar análises de ROI de iniciativas Cloud.

• Garantir aderência às políticas de tagging e governança de recursos.

• Construir dashboards, alertas e indicadores automatizados para acompanhamento técnico e financeiro.


Requisitos obrigatórios:

Conhecimento intermediário a avançado em Microsoft Azure, incluindo infraestrutura, serviços e tecnologias da plataforma.

• Experiência com Governança em Azure, contemplando:

  • Azure Cost Management
  • Azure Advisor
  • Azure Reservations
  • Azure Policies

• Conhecimento em estruturas de gerenciamento de recursos e organização de ambientes em nuvem:

  • Management Groups
  • Accounts/Subscriptions
  • Billing Groups

• Vivência em práticas de FinOps, incluindo:

  • Princípios da FinOps Foundation
  • Modelos de Showback e Chargeback
  • Alocação e rateio de custos em nuvem
  • Controle orçamentário e elaboração de forecast
  • Análise de custos por unidade de negócio, produto ou centro de custo
  • Interpretação de relatórios financeiros e operacionais

• Conhecimento em políticas de tagging, padronização e taxonomia Cloud.

• Experiência na criação de dashboards, relatórios gerenciais e visualização de dados.

• Certificações Microsoft Azure e/ou FinOps serão consideradas diferenciais.

title: Customer Support Representative, Level 1
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Customer Support Representative, Level 1 em camaçari. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

JoVE is the world- leading producer and provider of video solutions with the mission to improve scientific research and education. Millions of scientists, educators and students use JoVE for their research, teaching and learning. Our institutional clients comprise over 1,000 universities, colleges, and biopharma companies, including such leaders as Harvard, MIT, Yale, and Stanford. As a rapidly growing company, with offices in the USA, UK, Australia, and India servicing clients in over 60 countries, we are seeking talented and ambitious individuals to join our company.


The Role


We are seeking an experienced Customer Support Representative to be on the front lines by answering questions and troubleshooting technical problems. You will assist customers with JoVE’s products and also guide clients through any technical issue they might encounter. If you are an energetic self-starter problem solver with a basic technical background and excellent communication skills, we want to talk to you. The Support Team here at JoVE is providing support not only to external customers but also to internal JoVE employees on a 24x7 basis.


Responsibilities:


  • Manage large amounts of incoming tickets.
  • Provide support to answer inquiries on products.
  • Accept and handle technical requests.
  • Triage tickets to the correct L2 teams.
  • Follow communication procedures, guidelines and policies.
  • Provide accurate, valid and complete information by using the right methods/tools.
  • Build sustainable relationships and trust with customers through open communication.
  • Handle customer complaints, provide appropriate solutions and alternatives within the time limits; follow up to ensure resolution.
  • Keep records of customer interactions, process customer accounts and file documents.
  • Take the extra mile to engage customers.
  • Performs other specific duties or assignments as directed by Team Manager.


Skills And Qualifications:


  • A Bachelor’s in Computer Science or related field.
  • 2+ years of demonstrable experience in technical customer support.
  • Excellent communication and interpersonal skills, verbal and written, are required to effectively and accurately communicate in English.
  • Ability to communicate with both technical and non-technical personnel in a clear and easy fashion.
  • Possess an attention to detail.
  • Basic understanding of KPIs and Metrics.
  • Must be able to accommodate flexible work schedules based on business needs.
  • Must have technical/diagnostic ability along with analytical ability to diagnose problems above basics, and basic mechanical skills.
  • Basic understanding of frameworks such as Agile, ITIL, COBIT.
  • Proficient with ticketing tools ( Zendesk, Jira, Salesforce).


Why Join JoVE?


  • A competitive compensation package.
  • You will make a direct impact in accelerating science research and education.
  • Opportunity to work with global teams and in an environment that promotes innovation and collaboration.
  • Our strong promotion from within culture draws a clear path to advance your career with us

title: .NET Core Developer
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para .NET Core Developer em salvador. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

.NET Core Developer (Containerization & Application Support)

Remote

Contract


Position Overview

We are seeking a skilled and hands-on .NET Core Developer with strong experience in containerized application development and deployment. The ideal candidate will be responsible for enhancing existing .NET applications, supporting container-based deployments, and assisting internal teams with troubleshooting and optimization of containerized environments.

This role requires a strong development background combined with practical experience working with modern container technologies and cloud-native application practices.


Key Responsibilities

  • Design, develop, enhance, and maintain applications using .NET Core / ASP.NET Core
  • Develop and implement updates, enhancements, and bug fixes for existing .NET applications
  • Build, manage, and support containerized applications using Docker and related technologies
  • Assist internal teams with deployment, troubleshooting, and operational support for container-based applications
  • Diagnose and resolve issues related to application performance, container orchestration, and deployment pipelines
  • Collaborate with cross-functional teams including DevOps, Infrastructure, QA, and Product teams
  • Participate in code reviews and ensure adherence to development best practices
  • Support CI/CD pipeline integration and deployment automation efforts
  • Monitor application stability, scalability, and reliability in containerized environments
  • Document technical designs, deployment procedures, and troubleshooting steps


Required Skills & Qualifications

  • Strong experience in .NET Core / ASP.NET Core development
  • Proficiency in C# and modern backend development practices
  • Hands-on experience with container technologies such as Docker
  • Experience troubleshooting and supporting containerized applications in production environments
  • Familiarity with Kubernetes or container orchestration platforms
  • Experience with REST APIs, microservices architecture, and distributed systems
  • Understanding of CI/CD pipelines and DevOps practices
  • Knowledge of Git and version control best practices
  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills
  • Excellent communication and collaboration abilities


Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience working in cloud environments such as Azure or AWS
  • Exposure to AKS, EKS, or OpenShift environments
  • Familiarity with monitoring and logging tools for containerized applications
  • Experience supporting enterprise application deployments
  • Understanding of infrastructure automation and scripting

Your connection with Aubay starts in the following lines:

Aubay Portugal is a French multinational company that has been operating in the country since 2007, with offices in Lisbon and Porto. Your next adventure starts here!

description:

Hey, Dingus!


Yep, you read that right. Dingus & Zazzy is expanding, and we're on the hunt for a sharp, versatile Multidisciplinary Creative who can move fluidly across video, design, UI/UX, and AI, and make it all look effortless.


About Us


Dingus & Zazzy is a global digital marketing agency helping brands grow across every corner of the digital landscape. We offer an \"unlimited get-shit-done\" subscription for our clients, from websites to social to SEO and everything in between.


Our team is full of creatives, strategists, tech geeks, and builders who love making brands look, feel, and perform better online. If that sounds like your vibe, keep reading.

Ready for the ride of your life? Apply now!

title: Customer Support Representative, Level 1
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Customer Support Representative, Level 1 em feira de santana. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

JoVE is the world- leading producer and provider of video solutions with the mission to improve scientific research and education. Millions of scientists, educators and students use JoVE for their research, teaching and learning. Our institutional clients comprise over 1,000 universities, colleges, and biopharma companies, including such leaders as Harvard, MIT, Yale, and Stanford. As a rapidly growing company, with offices in the USA, UK, Australia, and India servicing clients in over 60 countries, we are seeking talented and ambitious individuals to join our company.


The Role


We are seeking an experienced Customer Support Representative to be on the front lines by answering questions and troubleshooting technical problems. You will assist customers with JoVE’s products and also guide clients through any technical issue they might encounter. If you are an energetic self-starter problem solver with a basic technical background and excellent communication skills, we want to talk to you. The Support Team here at JoVE is providing support not only to external customers but also to internal JoVE employees on a 24x7 basis.


Responsibilities:


  • Manage large amounts of incoming tickets.
  • Provide support to answer inquiries on products.
  • Accept and handle technical requests.
  • Triage tickets to the correct L2 teams.
  • Follow communication procedures, guidelines and policies.
  • Provide accurate, valid and complete information by using the right methods/tools.
  • Build sustainable relationships and trust with customers through open communication.
  • Handle customer complaints, provide appropriate solutions and alternatives within the time limits; follow up to ensure resolution.
  • Keep records of customer interactions, process customer accounts and file documents.
  • Take the extra mile to engage customers.
  • Performs other specific duties or assignments as directed by Team Manager.


Skills And Qualifications:


  • A Bachelor’s in Computer Science or related field.
  • 2+ years of demonstrable experience in technical customer support.
  • Excellent communication and interpersonal skills, verbal and written, are required to effectively and accurately communicate in English.
  • Ability to communicate with both technical and non-technical personnel in a clear and easy fashion.
  • Possess an attention to detail.
  • Basic understanding of KPIs and Metrics.
  • Must be able to accommodate flexible work schedules based on business needs.
  • Must have technical/diagnostic ability along with analytical ability to diagnose problems above basics, and basic mechanical skills.
  • Basic understanding of frameworks such as Agile, ITIL, COBIT.
  • Proficient with ticketing tools ( Zendesk, Jira, Salesforce).


Why Join JoVE?


  • A competitive compensation package.
  • You will make a direct impact in accelerating science research and education.
  • Opportunity to work with global teams and in an environment that promotes innovation and collaboration.
  • Our strong promotion from within culture draws a clear path to advance your career with us

Who We Are

DEXIAN is a global American consulting company focused on technology talent solutions to support and strengthen our clients’ IT teams. We are present in 10 countries, with 45 offices worldwide. For more than 25 years, DEXIAN® has been serving global clients across multiple industries, with the mission of attracting and retaining the world’s top talent.

In Brazil, we have been operating since 2007 and have successfully partnered with more than 50 clients from different sectors of the economy.

At DEXIAN, every movement is guided by five core values: collaboration, respect, fairness, commitment, and ingenuity. These are not just concepts — they define how we work, build partnerships, and support our teams every day.

If you share these values, this is the right place for you to grow your career.

DEXIAN Brazil strongly encourages diversity, and all opportunities are open to people with disabilities and rehabilitated professionals.

This position will support one of our clients, a global company focused in retail.


Key Responsibilities


  • Collaborates and pairs with other product team members (UX, engineering, and product management) to create secure, reliable, scalable software solutions
  • Writes custom code or scripts to automate infrastructure, monitoring services, and test cases

  • Experience and understanding of what Lambda Expressions and Streams are in Java 8
  • SQL experience (BigQuery)
  • Understanding of ML concepts
  • Experience using Spring Boot

  • Experience with Kubernetes
  • Experience writing Junit test cases

What is Teachable?

Teachable is trusted by creator-educators around the world to grow their impact and income. From online courses and communities to memberships and downloads, Teachable's digital learning products help creator-educators drive meaningful connection and sustainable revenue. With industry-best ecommerce tools, easily toggled on directly within the platform, creators can confidently maximize their earnings, while getting paid directly by their audience. Today, tens of thousands of creator-educators use Teachable to share their knowledge, reaching millions of students around the world. To learn more, visit teachable.com.

Now part of the global Hotmart Company portfolio, whose platforms have helped creators earn more than $10 billion, Teachable continues to take the creator economy by storm as a true industry leader. Together, Teachable and Hotmart are delivering market-leading products that prioritize creator control and flexibility, alongside meaningful partnership and support from our team. If you have big ideas, relish the chance to challenge convention, and deeply believe in the power of creators to shape the future, we want you on our team!


Your Mission

We are seeking a highly analytical and strategic Customer Success Operations Sr Analyst to strengthen our Customer Success strategy and accelerate our go-to-market engine in a rapidly growing SaaS company. You will partner with CS, Finance, Product, Marketing, and Data teams to design scalable processes, implement effective incentives and structures, and ensure execution aligns with business priorities. This is a high-impact role with strong visibility and influence across the organization.


Key Responsibilities:

  • Partner with CS and executive leadership to define the go-to-market strategy—including segmentation, sales motions, and revenue growth priorities.
  • Design and continuously refine quota-setting frameworks, territory models, and headcount planning to enable scalable growth.
  • Develop compensation strategies and incentive structures that drive exceptional performance while aligning with company objectives.
  • Build and manage strategic dashboards and frameworks to monitor CS productivity, NRR, Excel/Google Sheets as needed.
  • Translate business questions into analytical projects, delivering actionable insights to guide product focus, market entry, and commercial efficiency.
  • Drive operational rigor through annual/quarterly planning cycles, cross-functional alignment, and performance reviews.
  • Identify and implement process improvements across tools, data flows, and CRM workflows (HubSpot) to enhance efficiency at scale.


Requirements:

  • 3–4 years of experience in Customer Success Operations or Business Operations, preferably within a SaaS or technology company.
  • Strong proficiency in Excel/Sheets and CRM tools (HubSpot knowledge is a plus)
  • Solid understanding of SaaS metrics and revenue motions (new business, upsell, retention).
  • Excellent communication skills in English (both written and verbal).
  • Proven ability to collaborate cross-functionally and independently lead complex initiatives.
  • Comfortable presenting insights and recommendations to senior leadership.
  • Bachelor’s degree in Engineering, Economics, Business, or a related field.
  • Advanced spoken and written English skills.


Why Join Us?

  • Opportunity to work in a high-growth SaaS environment with global exposure.
  • Direct impact on go-to-market strategy and revenue growth.
  • Collaborative, data-driven, and entrepreneurial culture.
  • Competitive compensation and benefits package.
  • This is a role based in Brazil, and you’ll collaborate closely with teams across the U.S. and Brazil.


Your work will follow Brasilia Standard Time (BRT), and you’ll be hired as a CLT contract employee with compensation in BRL.

  • Experiência sólida com Spring Boot e JPA.
  • Conhecimentos em frontend: JavaScript, JQuery e JSTL.
  • Experiência com bancos de dados PostgreSQL e ferramenta Liquibase.

description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Multidisciplinary Creative em camaçari. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

Hey, Dingus!


Yep, you read that right. Dingus & Zazzy is expanding, and we're on the hunt for a sharp, versatile Multidisciplinary Creative who can move fluidly across video, design, UI/UX, and AI, and make it all look effortless.


About Us


Dingus & Zazzy is a global digital marketing agency helping brands grow across every corner of the digital landscape. We offer an \"unlimited get-shit-done\" subscription for our clients, from websites to social to SEO and everything in between.


Our team is full of creatives, strategists, tech geeks, and builders who love making brands look, feel, and perform better online. If that sounds like your vibe, keep reading.

  • Edit and produce video content across formats, social, brand, campaign, and everything in between.

  • Lead and execute UI/UX work, from wireframes and user flows to polished, production-ready interfaces.

What You Bring


  • 2+ years of hands-on experience across graphic design, video editing, and UI/UX, not just one of them.
  • A strong portfolio that proves you can move across disciplines without losing quality.
  • Proficiency in Adobe Creative Suite (Premiere Pro, After Effects, Illustrator, Photoshop), Figma, and Canva.
  • Real experience using AI tools in a creative workflow (image generation, video AI, copy assistance, etc.).
  • A solid eye for typography, layout, motion, and user experience.

  • Strong communication skills, you know how to present your work and take feedback like a pro.


Bonus Points

  • Experience in a digital agency or client-services environment.

Work Details


  • Hours: 9 A.M. – 5 P.M. MST, Monday to Friday
  • Requires a working level of written and spoken English


If you're someone who thrives on variety, gets excited by creative challenges across multiple disciplines, and loves using the latest tools to push work further, we want to hear from you.


Ready for the ride of your life? Apply now!


Note : Due to the high number of applicants across roles, responses and processes will take a while.

title: .NET Core Developer
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para .NET Core Developer em feira de santana. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

.NET Core Developer (Containerization & Application Support)

Remote

Contract


Position Overview

We are seeking a skilled and hands-on .NET Core Developer with strong experience in containerized application development and deployment. The ideal candidate will be responsible for enhancing existing .NET applications, supporting container-based deployments, and assisting internal teams with troubleshooting and optimization of containerized environments.

This role requires a strong development background combined with practical experience working with modern container technologies and cloud-native application practices.


Key Responsibilities

  • Design, develop, enhance, and maintain applications using .NET Core / ASP.NET Core
  • Develop and implement updates, enhancements, and bug fixes for existing .NET applications
  • Build, manage, and support containerized applications using Docker and related technologies
  • Assist internal teams with deployment, troubleshooting, and operational support for container-based applications
  • Diagnose and resolve issues related to application performance, container orchestration, and deployment pipelines
  • Collaborate with cross-functional teams including DevOps, Infrastructure, QA, and Product teams
  • Participate in code reviews and ensure adherence to development best practices
  • Support CI/CD pipeline integration and deployment automation efforts
  • Monitor application stability, scalability, and reliability in containerized environments
  • Document technical designs, deployment procedures, and troubleshooting steps


Required Skills & Qualifications

  • Strong experience in .NET Core / ASP.NET Core development
  • Proficiency in C# and modern backend development practices
  • Hands-on experience with container technologies such as Docker
  • Experience troubleshooting and supporting containerized applications in production environments
  • Familiarity with Kubernetes or container orchestration platforms
  • Experience with REST APIs, microservices architecture, and distributed systems
  • Understanding of CI/CD pipelines and DevOps practices
  • Knowledge of Git and version control best practices
  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills
  • Excellent communication and collaboration abilities


Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience working in cloud environments such as Azure or AWS
  • Exposure to AKS, EKS, or OpenShift environments
  • Familiarity with monitoring and logging tools for containerized applications
  • Experience supporting enterprise application deployments
  • Understanding of infrastructure automation and scripting

description:
