title: Fund Operations Analyst
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Fund Operations Analyst em camaçari. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar. The Role
We're looking for a highly organized, detail-oriented Fund Operations Analyst with 1 to 3 years of experience to join our team in São Paulo. This is a critical role in our firm's infrastructure, demanding both technical rigor and strong operational ownership.
You will be a key member of our back-office team, working directly with the CFO and senior partners to ensure the efficiency, compliance, and scalability of our fund's operations. You will own the \"engine room\" of an international investment fund — managing offshore structures, investor relations, financial controls, and regulatory compliance across multiple jurisdictions.
This role offers significant exposure to the full lifecycle of a growth-stage VC fund and direct interaction with world-class financial service providers.
Key Responsibilities
· Financial Management & Treasury — Own day-to-day treasury operations for both local (CNPJs) and offshore entities, including accounts payable/receivable, cash flow management, FX operations, and bank reconciliations.
· Fund Administration Management — Manage the relationship with external stakeholders of the fund's US entities, including Fund Administrators, legal counsel, tax advisors, and external auditors (Big 4).
· Investor Relations (IR) Operations — Execute Capital Calls, Distributions, and NAV calculations. Lead LP onboarding (KYC/AML) and serve as the primary point of contact for investor inquiries and reporting.
· Financial Reporting & Close — Lead monthly and quarterly close in coordination with external accountants. Review the fund's financial statements for accuracy and compliance (US GAAP / IFRS).
· Legal & Governance — Review fund documents (agreements, side letters, subscription docs) and maintain the Data Room to ensure audit readiness at all times.
· Fundraising Operations Support — Support capital raising processes, including Data Room management, LP due diligence coordination, and subscription document processing.
· Process Improvement — Continuously identify opportunities to improve operational efficiency and implement scalable processes and tools across the fund's back-office.
Requirements
· 1–3 years of experience in Fund Operations, Fund Administration, Audit (Big 4 or similar), or Corporate Finance / Treasury at a financial institution, investment fund, or large corporation.
· Bachelor's degree in Accounting, Business Administration, Economics, or a related field.
· Exceptional organizational skills and precision in financial data management.
· Advanced proficiency in Excel.
· Ability to interpret financial statements, understand fund accounting principles, and flag risks proactively.
· Ownership mentality — ability to manage multiple workflows autonomously and communicate effectively with senior stakeholders.
· Fluent English

  • Habilidade em analisar e resolver desafios complexos de múltiplas camadas, abrangendo aplicações, dados e infraestrutura. Experiência em automação, processamento em lote (Control-M/JCL) e modernização de ambientes legados.

  • Administração e manutenção

  • Performance tuning e análise

  • Rocket Enterprise Server .

  • Protocolos de transferência: SFTP, FTPS .



Idiomas

  • Alemão (diferencial relevante)

  • Disponibilidade para atuar no fuso horário da Alemanha .

title: AI Implementation Lead (Technical PM for Agents & Agentic / Automated Systems)
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para AI Implementation Lead (Technical PM for Agents & Agentic / Automated Systems) em feira de santana. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

Zaigo builds custom AI systems for founder-led, middle-market companies — the kind of businesses with messy operations, real revenue, and legacy software in place. They are thinking about how to leverage AI but don't know where to start. We turn manual workflows and inefficiencies into production AI systems, fast.


We are hiring an AI Implementation Lead to own client delivery end-to-end inside a pod structure. You will run 5–10 client accounts at once, with 2–3 senior AI engineers reporting into your pod, and you will be the person the client trusts to get things shipped.


Think of this as a principal-level role at a consulting firm : a senior partner sets the strategy and owns the relationship at the top, you own the execution and the day-to-day client trust, and your engineers do the heavy build. You are the person who keeps everything moving, makes the calls, and ships.


What you'll actually do


Own the client. You'll run discovery calls, scope the work, set expectations, give status updates, manage scope creep, and be the steady hand the client calls when something is on fire. Many of our clients are non-technical executives running real businesses — you need to be able to translate \"we have this messy thing happening in our operations\" into a concrete AI system, in plain English, without jargon.


Architect the solution. On a discovery call, you should be able to sketch out a working solution in real time: \"Okay, this is a RAG problem with a chat layer on top, we'll use these 5 specialized agents to handle X, Y, and Z, output formatted to your Excel template, and we'll integrate with your existing CRM via API calls.\" You don't need to write the production code, but you need to know enough to confidently scope it, pick the right framework, point to the right open-source repo, and know roughly what's hard vs. easy.


Run the pod. Translate the scoped solution into engineering tasks, hand it off cleanly, unblock the engineers, and review the work. You can't read every line of AI-generated code — nobody can anymore. You're evaluating whether the output is directionally right, whether the UX makes sense, whether the architecture will hold up, and whether it actually solves the client's problem. Strong product intuition matters more than line-by-line review.


Prototype when needed. You're a player-coach. You should be comfortable opening Cursor or Claude Code to validate an approach, build a quick demo for a client call, or prototype a tricky workflow before handing it to engineers. You're not shipping production code as your main job, but you can build.


Juggle. You'll have ~10 active projects across 5–10 clients at any time. Deadlines slip, priorities shift, clients change their minds. You stay calm, communicate proactively, and keep everything moving.


Who you are


You have at least 5–8 years of experience in some combination of technical product management, solutions engineering, technical consulting, forward-deployed engineering, or running your own thing. You may have been a founder. You may have been a PM at a fast company who got tired of waiting for engineers and started vibe coding your own stuff.


You're technically literate in a hands-on way: you can vibe code, you know the major agentic frameworks (Claude Agent SDK, Vercel AI SDK etc.), you understand RAG architectures, you know when to use a vector DB vs. a graph DB vs. just dumping things into context, you've shipped things using AI tools.


You communicate exceptionally well in English, both written and verbal. You're comfortable on a Zoom call with a 62-year-old CEO who has never heard of Loom and explaining to him, patiently, what we're building and why it matters for his business.

You have founder-grade ownership. You don't say \"that wasn't in the ticket.\" You don't wait for someone to tell you what to do next. You see the gap, you close it.


This role is for you if


You can take a messy business problem and produce a clear, shippable architecture for it within a single call.


You like running a lot of things at once and you don't drop balls.


You're excited about AI-assisted building and you use these tools every day already.


You want to work alongside experienced founders and senior engineers, with real ownership and real client exposure, in a fast-growing company.


This role is not for you if


You want to write production code all day.


You're a pure project manager who needs a PRD and a Jira board to function.


You're uncomfortable on the phone with non-technical executives.


You need a manager to tell you what to prioritize this week.


You avoid ambiguity.


Location


Fully remote. We're focused on candidates based in Brazil with strong daily overlap with U.S. Eastern Time.


How to apply


To apply, please email (not DM) the following directly to and copy :


  • Your resume
  • A short Loom video (5–10 minutes max, must be a Loom link) walking us through one technical or operational project you personally owned



In the Loom, cover:

  • The business problem you were solving
  • Your specific role
  • The technical workflow or architecture at a high level
  • The biggest challenge you solved
  • How you organized and managed delivery



We strongly prefer candidates who can explain complex technical systems clearly, concisely, and in plain English.


  • Applications without a Loom video will not be considered.

title: Desenvolvedor(a) Fullstack Sênior (Node e React)
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Desenvolvedor(a) Fullstack Sênior (Node e React) em salvador. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

Olá, somos a SuperFrete :)


Queremos ser a maior e mais amada rede de logística digital, quer fazer parte disso?


Somos uma startup que atua no segmento do varejo e logística, apoiando os pequenos e médios empreendedores a se tornarem mais competitivos no mercado e a alavancarem suas vendas. Por isso, buscamos um Super Desenvolvedor(a) Fullstack Sênior atuando de forma com Node e React, que se identifique com o nosso propósito, que tenha muita energia para somar no time de Tecnologia e que queira crescer (muito!) com a gente.


Responsabilidades:

  • Desenvolver, manter e evoluir aplicações backend e frontend utilizando Node.js, TypeScript, JavaScript e React
  • Participar da definição e evolução da arquitetura, propondo soluções escaláveis, performáticas e sustentáveis;
  • Atuar no desenvolvimento e manutenção de aplicações web e mobile;
  • Integrar aplicações com serviços de nuvem, bancos de dados e iniciativas de DevOps, garantindo escalabilidade e confiabilidade;
  • Participar de code reviews e promover boas práticas, qualidade e consistência do código;
  • Realizar análises e viabilidades técnicas, avaliando impactos, complexidade, aderência arquitetural e estratégias de implementação para apoiar decisões e priorizações do negócio;
  • Explorar, testar e propor o uso de soluções e ferramentas baseadas em IA que contribuam para ganho de produtividade, melhoria da experiência do usuário e evolução dos produtos;
  • Trabalhar em conjunto com times multidisciplinares para resolver problemas complexos e construir soluções alinhadas ao negócio.


Requisitos:

  • Sólida experiência com desenvolvimento backend e frontend utilizando Node.js, TypeScript, JavaScript e React;
  • Experiência com gerenciamento de estado utilizando Redux e/ou Zustand;
  • Experiência com serviços de nuvem como Firebase, AWS, GCloud ou similares;
  • Familiaridade com bancos de dados relacionais e não relacionais, como Postgres e MongoDB;
  • Experiência com testes automatizados e práticas de qualidade de software;
  • Conhecimento em arquitetura de software, APIs, padrões de desenvolvimento e boas práticas (Clean Code/Clean Architecture);
  • Experiência com práticas de DevOps, automação e pipelines CI/CD;
  • Vivência com arquitetura orientada a serviços e/ou ambientes serverless;
  • Experiência com Git e metodologias ágeis (Scrum/Kanban);
  • Interesse, familiaridade ou experiência no uso de recursos de Inteligência Artificial aplicados ao desenvolvimento, automação e produtividade, utilizando ferramentas como Cursor, Copilot, Claude, ChatGPT ou similares, além de iniciativas de aprendizado contínuo no tema;
  • Capacidade de resolver problemas complexos e construir soluções escaláveis.


Diferenciais:

  • Vivência em construção, evolução e definição de arquitetura técnica;
  • Experiência ou potencial para atuar como referência técnica ou evoluir para uma posição de Tech Lead, apoiando decisões técnicas, mentoria e desenvolvimento do time;
  • Experiência com tecnologias de desenvolvimento mobile ou híbrido, como React Native, Capacitor, Cordova ou Ionic;
  • Experiência em ambientes de startup e crescimento acelerado.


O que você pode esperar dos Supers?

  • Uma cultura de muita confiança, colaboração, focada em resultados, com muita autonomia e transparência;
  • Buscamos excelência em tudo o que fazemos, por isso estamos sempre aprendendo;
  • Temos vontade de construir junto, fazer a diferença e gerar impacto.


O que oferecemos:

title: Senior Application Architect
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Senior Application Architect em lauro de freitas. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

A T-Systems , multinacional alemã pertencente ao Grupo Deutsche Telekom , busca profissional sênior de TI com sólida experiência híbrida em arquitetura de aplicações, desenvolvimento e gerenciamento de bancos de dados, com foco particular na integração de sistemas externos por meio de tecnologias middleware como MQ, Kafka, SFTP e CFT.   • Experiência comprovada no projeto e implementação de soluções de integração ponta a ponta, conectando aplicações mainframe com ambientes de nuvem e Linux (Azure).

  • Experiência prática com plataformas middleware (IBM MQ, Axway CFT), protocolos de transferência de arquivos (SFTP/FTPS) e streaming de eventos (Kafka), possibilitando a troca de dados robusta e eficiente em ambientes de sistemas heterogêneos.
  • Habilidade em analisar e resolver desafios complexos de múltiplas camadas, abrangendo aplicações, dados e infraestrutura. Experiência em automação, processamento em lote (Control-M/JCL) e modernização de ambientes legados.
  • Reconhecido por uma mentalidade holística, orientada à arquitetura, fortes habilidades de resolução de problemas e comunicação eficaz com stakeholders técnicos e de negócios em ambientes internacionais.



Requisitos Técnicos


  • COBOL – experiência prática em desenvolvimento e entendimento de sistemas legados.
  • DB2 LUW e/ou DB2 z/OS :
  • Administração e manutenção
  • Backups e recovery
  • Modelagem e DDL (ex: criação de tabelas)
  • Gerenciamento de índices
  • Performance tuning e análise
  • Carga e extração de dados (Load/Unload)
  • Conhecimentos em Mainframe e sua integração com sistemas distribuídos.
  • Cloud (Azure) e ambientes Linux , incluindo automação via scripting.
  • Control-M / JCL – criação e administração de workflows e agendamento de jobs.
  • IBM MQ – configuração de channels, queues e uso de ferramentas como MQ Explorer.
  • Rocket Enterprise Server .
  • Axway CFT – configuração de fluxos de transferência.
  • Protocolos de transferência: SFTP, FTPS .



Idiomas

  • Inglês avançado (mandatório)
  • Alemão (diferencial relevante)



Outros Requisitos

  • Disponibilidade para atuar no fuso horário da Alemanha .

Our client is a Business Intelligence platform enabling customers to connect multiple data sources (e.g., Excel, SQL) into a unified environment, build interactive dashboards, apply formulas, and customize via plugins, scripts, and embedding. title: Technical Support Engineer (Analytics Focused)
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Technical Support Engineer (Analytics Focused) em lauro de freitas. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

Company & Product

Our client is a Business Intelligence platform enabling customers to connect multiple data sources (e.g., Excel, SQL) into a unified environment, build interactive dashboards, apply formulas, and customize via plugins, scripts, and embedding. The product supports both SaaS and on-prem deployments. Support is organized into 4 pods: Analytics, DevEx, Data, and Infra.


About Role and Team:

As a Technical Support Engineer you will work with leading enterprise organizations and startups to realize the power of data analytics. Our Technical Support team spans the globe and has recently begun a major transformation effort to move to a SWARM model for our tools, processes, and organizational structure. This shift focuses on driving a collaborative, rewarding environment that measures value creation and team playing. Our team is aligned directly with our Product and Engineering teams through a robust Subject Matter Expert program.


Responsibilities:

● Investigate technical problems and diagnose root causes in Linux and Windows servers

● Develop, design, and propose solutions to meet the technological and business needs of customers (e.g. workarounds for product issues and additional features)

● Manage critical issues that impact customer’s business

● Work with R&D and Product teams to meet customer requirements and improve our product

● Present complex technical information about the product to the customers

● Take part in the creation and maintenance of our knowledge-based and community

● Work with Linux shell, RestAPI, Web applications troubleshooting, application installations, identifying process improvements, debugging, comprehending technical documents


Work Hours : US East business hours.


Main Skills (What You’ve Already Accomplished...So Far):

● You already experienced with supporting complex product infrastructure and applications

● You have experience with troubleshooting web applications

● You have experience with databases such as MS SQL, MySQL, Oracle etc, SQL scripting at least at basic level

● You already worked with ETL and BI tools such as Microsoft Power BI, Talend, SSRS, BusinessObjects, Cognos etc OR you are able to write and understand complex formulas

● You have experience working with logs, and various monitoring tools such as Grafana, New Relic, Kibana

● You are familiar with Linux

● You have experience in communication with English-speaking customers


Nice to have:

● Experience with virtualization and cloud services (AWS, vSphere)

● Web development background and/or programming familiarity ( specifically JavaScript)

● Experience with NoSQL databases such as MongoDB or Hadoop

● Experience with RestAPI

● Networking knowledges

We're looking for a multi-disciplinary Video Creator / Creative Editor who doesn’t wait to be told that something ‘could be better’.

  • A deep understanding of hooks, pacing, retention, and platform-native editing
  • Clean workflow habits: methodical, organised, no missed deadlines and excellent communication.

  • You anticipate roadblocks and resolve issues independently before escalating
  • You meet deadlines consistently and flag potential delays early
  • You bring fresh ideas, formats, and techniques to every project

───────────────────────────────

WHY JOIN US:

  • 100% remote, flexible working
  • Full creative ownership from day one without micromanagement
  • International brands and creator campaigns
  • Performance bonuses + genuine path to a core creative role
  • Upskilling with AI workflows and content systems

───────────────────────────────

HOW TO APPLY:

  • Complete the required creative assessment first:
  • Include your portfolio, CV, and a 2–4 sentence cover note.
  • IMPORTANT: Applications without a completed assessment will not be considered.

We're looking for a multi-disciplinary Video Creator / Creative Editor who doesn’t wait to be told that something ‘could be better’.

title: Consultor de Estratégia e Transformação Digital | Industry & Services
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Consultor de Estratégia e Transformação Digital | Industry & Services em feira de santana. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

Buscamos um consultor sênior para integrar o time de advisory e pré-vendas da vertical Industry & Services, com foco em estratégia, transformação digital e operações industriais. Atuará no diagnóstico de problemas de negócio, na estruturação de soluções e na condução de conversas estratégicas com clientes, traduzindo oportunidades operacionais em propostas de valor sustentadas por tecnologia, dados e IA.


Principais responsabilidades

  • Conduzir discovery, diagnósticos operacionais e mapeamento de processos em clientes de óleo e gás, mineração, manufatura e setores correlatos, identificando oportunidades de eficiência e modernização.
  • Estruturar soluções de transformação digital, conectando dores de negócio a iniciativas de tecnologia, automação, analytics e IA generativa.
  • Construir propostas, decks executivos e materiais consultivos com qualidade e velocidade para suportar o ciclo de pré-vendas e conversas com lideranças do cliente.
  • Conduzir interações client facing com áreas de negócio e tecnologia, garantindo alinhamento de expectativas, priorização e clareza de valor.
  • Articular o ecossistema interno (especialistas, delivery, parceiros) para montar respostas integradas dentro dos prazos comerciais.
  • Apoiar a evolução do portfólio de ofertas da vertical, trazendo leitura de mercado, tendências e cases que inspirem novas oportunidades.


Perfil que buscamos

  • Formação em Engenharia, Administração, Economia ou áreas correlatas, com pós-graduação ou MBA considerados um diferencial.
  • Experiência sólida em consultoria (Big 4, boutiques de estratégia ou integradores) atuando em projetos de transformação digital, supply chain, operações ou estratégia para clientes industriais.
  • Vivência em diagnóstico de processos, modelagem de soluções e gestão de iniciativas em ambientes complexos e multidisciplinares.
  • Vivência com Arquitetura de Dados, AI/GenAI, Machine Learning e componentes Cloud.
  • Familiaridade com temas de Indústria 4.0, convergência IT/OT, supply chain analytics, gestão de ativos, torre de controle ou aplicações de IA em operações.
  • Domínio de Power BI e Excel avançado; conhecimentos de Python, SQL ou plataformas de dados são bem-vindos.
  • Inglês avançado para interlocução com fornecedores, parceiros e times globais.
  • Postura consultiva, estruturação clara de raciocínio, velocidade na construção de materiais e energia para conduzir o ambiente e conectar pessoas.


Diferenciais

  • Experiência prévia em projetos para Agro, Alimentos & Bebidas, Bens de Consumo, Auto, Mineradoras ou grandes indústrias de Manufatura.
  • Vivência prática em iniciativas com IA generativa, agentes de LLM ou analytics avançado aplicado a operações.

title: Backend Team Lead (PHP/Laravel)
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Backend Team Lead (PHP/Laravel) em camaçari. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

Backend Team Lead (PHP/Laravel)


Location: Brazil (Remote)


Our trusted high-growth healthcare technology partner is seeking a talented Backend Team Lead (PHP/Laravel) to join their dynamic team. This innovative company is dedicated to revolutionizing the healthcare industry through cutting-edge technology solutions.


Position Overview


As a Backend Team Lead , you will play a key role in leading the backend development team while contributing to the development and implementation of scalable and robust software solutions that support the company's mission and goals. You will guide and support the backend team while working closely with cross-functional teams to design, build, and maintain innovative applications and platforms that drive business success and improve patient outcomes.


Primary Responsibilities


  • Team Leadership:

Lead and support the backend engineering team, ensuring effective collaboration, task distribution, and delivery of high-quality software.

  • Platform Development:

Spearhead the development and optimization of our EHR platform using PHP/Laravel , ensuring high performance, reliability, and scalability.

  • Database Development:

Creating database schemas that represent and support business processes.

  • API Development and Integration:

Develop and maintain APIs for internal and external use, facilitating seamless integration with other healthcare systems and third-party services.

  • Security Compliance:

Ensure the platform's compliance with healthcare industry standards, including HIPAA , by implementing and maintaining robust security measures and data protection protocols.


Additional Responsibilities


  • Mentor backend developers, providing guidance on best practices in backend development, code review, and team collaboration.
  • Support the team in resolving technical challenges and ensure consistent development standards across the team.
  • Stay abreast of new technology trends and evaluate their application to continually innovate and enhance the platform.
  • Participate in an agile development environment, contributing to team coordination and iterative delivery processes, ensuring timely delivery of high-quality software.


Competencies / Requirements


  • Technical Expertise:

Strong proficiency in PHP/Laravel and MySQL . Familiarity with version control tools, preferably Git .

  • Experience:

At least 6+ years of experience in backend development , with a proven track record of developing and maintaining scalable web applications. Previous experience leading or mentoring developers is required. Experience in the healthcare sector or EHR platforms is highly desirable.

  • Problem-Solving Skills:

Ability to tackle complex problems, think analytically, and develop innovative solutions.

  • Communication Skills:

Excellent verbal and written communication skills, capable of effectively collaborating with cross-functional teams and stakeholders.

  • Attention to Detail:

A strong focus on code quality, adherence to design specifications, and a commitment to creating a user-friendly, secure, and efficient platform.


Benefits

  • Competitive salary to recognize and reward your achievements.
  • Flexible work environment.
  • Opportunities for professional and personal growth.

title: Senior Application Architect
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Senior Application Architect em salvador. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

A T-Systems , multinacional alemã pertencente ao Grupo Deutsche Telekom , busca profissional sênior de TI com sólida experiência híbrida em arquitetura de aplicações, desenvolvimento e gerenciamento de bancos de dados, com foco particular na integração de sistemas externos por meio de tecnologias middleware como MQ, Kafka, SFTP e CFT. Especializado em ambientes COBOL e DB2 (LUW/zOS), com vasta experiência na integração de sistemas legados e plataformas distribuídas modernas.



Perfil desejado


  • Experiência comprovada no projeto e implementação de soluções de integração ponta a ponta, conectando aplicações mainframe com ambientes de nuvem e Linux (Azure).
  • Sólida experiência em administração de DB2, otimização de desempenho, modelagem de dados e integração de dados, garantindo alta disponibilidade, escalabilidade e confiabilidade de sistemas de missão crítica.
  • Experiência prática com plataformas middleware (IBM MQ, Axway CFT), protocolos de transferência de arquivos (SFTP/FTPS) e streaming de eventos (Kafka), possibilitando a troca de dados robusta e eficiente em ambientes de sistemas heterogêneos.
  • Habilidade em analisar e resolver desafios complexos de múltiplas camadas, abrangendo aplicações, dados e infraestrutura. Experiência em automação, processamento em lote (Control-M/JCL) e modernização de ambientes legados.
  • Reconhecido por uma mentalidade holística, orientada à arquitetura, fortes habilidades de resolução de problemas e comunicação eficaz com stakeholders técnicos e de negócios em ambientes internacionais.



Requisitos Técnicos


  • COBOL – experiência prática em desenvolvimento e entendimento de sistemas legados.
  • DB2 LUW e/ou DB2 z/OS :
  • Administração e manutenção
  • Backups e recovery
  • Modelagem e DDL (ex: criação de tabelas)
  • Gerenciamento de índices
  • Performance tuning e análise
  • Carga e extração de dados (Load/Unload)
  • Conhecimentos em Mainframe e sua integração com sistemas distribuídos.
  • Cloud (Azure) e ambientes Linux , incluindo automação via scripting.
  • Control-M / JCL – criação e administração de workflows e agendamento de jobs.
  • IBM MQ – configuração de channels, queues e uso de ferramentas como MQ Explorer.
  • Rocket Enterprise Server .
  • Axway CFT – configuração de fluxos de transferência.
  • Protocolos de transferência: SFTP, FTPS .

title: AI Implementation Lead (Technical PM for Agents & Agentic / Automated Systems)
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para AI Implementation Lead (Technical PM for Agents & Agentic / Automated Systems) em camaçari. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

Zaigo builds custom AI systems for founder-led, middle-market companies — the kind of businesses with messy operations, real revenue, and legacy software in place. They are thinking about how to leverage AI but don't know where to start. We turn manual workflows and inefficiencies into production AI systems, fast.


We are hiring an AI Implementation Lead to own client delivery end-to-end inside a pod structure. You will run 5–10 client accounts at once, with 2–3 senior AI engineers reporting into your pod, and you will be the person the client trusts to get things shipped.


Think of this as a principal-level role at a consulting firm : a senior partner sets the strategy and owns the relationship at the top, you own the execution and the day-to-day client trust, and your engineers do the heavy build. You are the person who keeps everything moving, makes the calls, and ships.


What you'll actually do


Own the client. You'll run discovery calls, scope the work, set expectations, give status updates, manage scope creep, and be the steady hand the client calls when something is on fire. Many of our clients are non-technical executives running real businesses — you need to be able to translate \"we have this messy thing happening in our operations\" into a concrete AI system, in plain English, without jargon.


Architect the solution. On a discovery call, you should be able to sketch out a working solution in real time: \"Okay, this is a RAG problem with a chat layer on top, we'll use these 5 specialized agents to handle X, Y, and Z, output formatted to your Excel template, and we'll integrate with your existing CRM via API calls.\" You don't need to write the production code, but you need to know enough to confidently scope it, pick the right framework, point to the right open-source repo, and know roughly what's hard vs. easy.


Run the pod. Translate the scoped solution into engineering tasks, hand it off cleanly, unblock the engineers, and review the work. You can't read every line of AI-generated code — nobody can anymore. You're evaluating whether the output is directionally right, whether the UX makes sense, whether the architecture will hold up, and whether it actually solves the client's problem. Strong product intuition matters more than line-by-line review.


Prototype when needed. You're a player-coach. You should be comfortable opening Cursor or Claude Code to validate an approach, build a quick demo for a client call, or prototype a tricky workflow before handing it to engineers. You're not shipping production code as your main job, but you can build.


Juggle. You'll have ~10 active projects across 5–10 clients at any time. Deadlines slip, priorities shift, clients change their minds. You stay calm, communicate proactively, and keep everything moving.


Who you are


You have at least 5–8 years of experience in some combination of technical product management, solutions engineering, technical consulting, forward-deployed engineering, or running your own thing. You may have been a founder. You may have been a PM at a fast company who got tired of waiting for engineers and started vibe coding your own stuff.


You're technically literate in a hands-on way: you can vibe code, you know the major agentic frameworks (Claude Agent SDK, Vercel AI SDK etc.), you understand RAG architectures, you know when to use a vector DB vs. a graph DB vs. just dumping things into context, you've shipped things using AI tools.


You communicate exceptionally well in English, both written and verbal. You're comfortable on a Zoom call with a 62-year-old CEO who has never heard of Loom and explaining to him, patiently, what we're building and why it matters for his business.

You have founder-grade ownership. You don't say \"that wasn't in the ticket.\" You don't wait for someone to tell you what to do next. You see the gap, you close it.


This role is for you if


You can take a messy business problem and produce a clear, shippable architecture for it within a single call.


You like running a lot of things at once and you don't drop balls.


You're excited about AI-assisted building and you use these tools every day already.


You want to work alongside experienced founders and senior engineers, with real ownership and real client exposure, in a fast-growing company.


This role is not for you if


You want to write production code all day.


You're a pure project manager who needs a PRD and a Jira board to function.


You're uncomfortable on the phone with non-technical executives.


You need a manager to tell you what to prioritize this week.


You avoid ambiguity.


Location


Fully remote. We're focused on candidates based in Brazil with strong daily overlap with U.S. Eastern Time.


How to apply


To apply, please email (not DM) the following directly to and copy :


  • Your resume
  • A short Loom video (5–10 minutes max, must be a Loom link) walking us through one technical or operational project you personally owned



In the Loom, cover:

  • The business problem you were solving
  • Your specific role
  • The technical workflow or architecture at a high level
  • The biggest challenge you solved
  • How you organized and managed delivery



We strongly prefer candidates who can explain complex technical systems clearly, concisely, and in plain English.


  • Applications without a Loom video will not be considered.

title: Desenvolvedor(a) Fullstack Sênior (Node e React)
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Desenvolvedor(a) Fullstack Sênior (Node e React) em feira de santana. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

Olá, somos a SuperFrete :)


Queremos ser a maior e mais amada rede de logística digital, quer fazer parte disso?


Somos uma startup que atua no segmento do varejo e logística, apoiando os pequenos e médios empreendedores a se tornarem mais competitivos no mercado e a alavancarem suas vendas. Por isso, buscamos um Super Desenvolvedor(a) Fullstack Sênior atuando de forma com Node e React, que se identifique com o nosso propósito, que tenha muita energia para somar no time de Tecnologia e que queira crescer (muito!) com a gente.


Responsabilidades:

  • Desenvolver, manter e evoluir aplicações backend e frontend utilizando Node.js, TypeScript, JavaScript e React
  • Participar da definição e evolução da arquitetura, propondo soluções escaláveis, performáticas e sustentáveis;
  • Atuar no desenvolvimento e manutenção de aplicações web e mobile;
  • Integrar aplicações com serviços de nuvem, bancos de dados e iniciativas de DevOps, garantindo escalabilidade e confiabilidade;
  • Participar de code reviews e promover boas práticas, qualidade e consistência do código;
  • Realizar análises e viabilidades técnicas, avaliando impactos, complexidade, aderência arquitetural e estratégias de implementação para apoiar decisões e priorizações do negócio;
  • Explorar, testar e propor o uso de soluções e ferramentas baseadas em IA que contribuam para ganho de produtividade, melhoria da experiência do usuário e evolução dos produtos;
  • Trabalhar em conjunto com times multidisciplinares para resolver problemas complexos e construir soluções alinhadas ao negócio.


Requisitos:

  • Sólida experiência com desenvolvimento backend e frontend utilizando Node.js, TypeScript, JavaScript e React;
  • Experiência com gerenciamento de estado utilizando Redux e/ou Zustand;
  • Experiência com serviços de nuvem como Firebase, AWS, GCloud ou similares;
  • Familiaridade com bancos de dados relacionais e não relacionais, como Postgres e MongoDB;
  • Experiência com testes automatizados e práticas de qualidade de software;
  • Conhecimento em arquitetura de software, APIs, padrões de desenvolvimento e boas práticas (Clean Code/Clean Architecture);
  • Experiência com práticas de DevOps, automação e pipelines CI/CD;
  • Vivência com arquitetura orientada a serviços e/ou ambientes serverless;
  • Experiência com Git e metodologias ágeis (Scrum/Kanban);
  • Interesse, familiaridade ou experiência no uso de recursos de Inteligência Artificial aplicados ao desenvolvimento, automação e produtividade, utilizando ferramentas como Cursor, Copilot, Claude, ChatGPT ou similares, além de iniciativas de aprendizado contínuo no tema;
  • Capacidade de resolver problemas complexos e construir soluções escaláveis.


Diferenciais:

  • Vivência em construção, evolução e definição de arquitetura técnica;
  • Experiência ou potencial para atuar como referência técnica ou evoluir para uma posição de Tech Lead, apoiando decisões técnicas, mentoria e desenvolvimento do time;
  • Experiência com tecnologias de desenvolvimento mobile ou híbrido, como React Native, Capacitor, Cordova ou Ionic;
  • Experiência em ambientes de startup e crescimento acelerado.


O que você pode esperar dos Supers?

  • Uma cultura de muita confiança, colaboração, focada em resultados, com muita autonomia e transparência;
  • Buscamos excelência em tudo o que fazemos, por isso estamos sempre aprendendo;
  • Temos vontade de construir junto, fazer a diferença e gerar impacto.


O que oferecemos:

Sycomp’s diverse team of consultants and engineers deliver on the company’s mission to tackle challenging global IT projects through its state-of-the-art integration and warehouse centers and global technology partnerships. title: AI Implementation Lead (Technical PM for Agents & Agentic / Automated Systems)
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para AI Implementation Lead (Technical PM for Agents & Agentic / Automated Systems) em salvador. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

Zaigo builds custom AI systems for founder-led, middle-market companies — the kind of businesses with messy operations, real revenue, and legacy software in place. They are thinking about how to leverage AI but don't know where to start. We turn manual workflows and inefficiencies into production AI systems, fast.


We are hiring an AI Implementation Lead to own client delivery end-to-end inside a pod structure. You will run 5–10 client accounts at once, with 2–3 senior AI engineers reporting into your pod, and you will be the person the client trusts to get things shipped.


Think of this as a principal-level role at a consulting firm : a senior partner sets the strategy and owns the relationship at the top, you own the execution and the day-to-day client trust, and your engineers do the heavy build. You are the person who keeps everything moving, makes the calls, and ships.


What you'll actually do


Own the client. You'll run discovery calls, scope the work, set expectations, give status updates, manage scope creep, and be the steady hand the client calls when something is on fire. Many of our clients are non-technical executives running real businesses — you need to be able to translate \"we have this messy thing happening in our operations\" into a concrete AI system, in plain English, without jargon.


Architect the solution. On a discovery call, you should be able to sketch out a working solution in real time: \"Okay, this is a RAG problem with a chat layer on top, we'll use these 5 specialized agents to handle X, Y, and Z, output formatted to your Excel template, and we'll integrate with your existing CRM via API calls.\" You don't need to write the production code, but you need to know enough to confidently scope it, pick the right framework, point to the right open-source repo, and know roughly what's hard vs. easy.


Run the pod. Translate the scoped solution into engineering tasks, hand it off cleanly, unblock the engineers, and review the work. You can't read every line of AI-generated code — nobody can anymore. You're evaluating whether the output is directionally right, whether the UX makes sense, whether the architecture will hold up, and whether it actually solves the client's problem. Strong product intuition matters more than line-by-line review.


Prototype when needed. You're a player-coach. You should be comfortable opening Cursor or Claude Code to validate an approach, build a quick demo for a client call, or prototype a tricky workflow before handing it to engineers. You're not shipping production code as your main job, but you can build.


Juggle. You'll have ~10 active projects across 5–10 clients at any time. Deadlines slip, priorities shift, clients change their minds. You stay calm, communicate proactively, and keep everything moving.


Who you are


You have at least 5–8 years of experience in some combination of technical product management, solutions engineering, technical consulting, forward-deployed engineering, or running your own thing. You may have been a founder. You may have been a PM at a fast company who got tired of waiting for engineers and started vibe coding your own stuff.


You're technically literate in a hands-on way: you can vibe code, you know the major agentic frameworks (Claude Agent SDK, Vercel AI SDK etc.), you understand RAG architectures, you know when to use a vector DB vs. a graph DB vs. just dumping things into context, you've shipped things using AI tools.


You communicate exceptionally well in English, both written and verbal. You're comfortable on a Zoom call with a 62-year-old CEO who has never heard of Loom and explaining to him, patiently, what we're building and why it matters for his business.

You have founder-grade ownership. You don't say \"that wasn't in the ticket.\" You don't wait for someone to tell you what to do next. You see the gap, you close it.


This role is for you if


You can take a messy business problem and produce a clear, shippable architecture for it within a single call.


You like running a lot of things at once and you don't drop balls.


You're excited about AI-assisted building and you use these tools every day already.


You want to work alongside experienced founders and senior engineers, with real ownership and real client exposure, in a fast-growing company.


This role is not for you if


You want to write production code all day.


You're a pure project manager who needs a PRD and a Jira board to function.


You're uncomfortable on the phone with non-technical executives.


You need a manager to tell you what to prioritize this week.


You avoid ambiguity.


Location


Fully remote. We're focused on candidates based in Brazil with strong daily overlap with U.S. Eastern Time.


How to apply


To apply, please email (not DM) the following directly to and copy :


  • Your resume
  • A short Loom video (5–10 minutes max, must be a Loom link) walking us through one technical or operational project you personally owned



In the Loom, cover:

  • The business problem you were solving
  • Your specific role
  • The technical workflow or architecture at a high level
  • The biggest challenge you solved
  • How you organized and managed delivery



We strongly prefer candidates who can explain complex technical systems clearly, concisely, and in plain English.


  • Applications without a Loom video will not be considered.

*OPORTUNIDADE PARA MÉDICO ONCOLOGISTA GENÉTICO NA TELADOC HEALTH\"


Junte-se à Nossa Equipe de Saúde Digital!


A Teladoc Health, líder global em saúde digital e inovação em cuidados de saúde, está buscando Médicos e Médicas Especialistas em Oncologia Genética! Se você é um profissional comprometido com a excelência no atendimento ao paciente e deseja fazer parte de uma revolução na prestação de serviços de saúde, esta é a oportunidade que você estava esperando.


*SOBRE A TELADOC HEALTH: *

A Teladoc Health está na vanguarda da transformação da saúde, oferecendo acesso rápido, conveniente e confiável a serviços de saúde através de nossa plataforma digital. Nossa missão é tornar o cuidado de saúde acessível a todos, em qualquer lugar e a qualquer momento. Combinando tecnologia de ponta e conhecimento médico, estamos moldando o futuro da saúde e proporcionando impacto positivo na vida de milhões de pessoas.


*O QUE PROCURAMOS: *


Você será responsável por realizar consultas por vídeo e telefone, por intermédio de plataforma do empregador, atendendo na especialidade de Oncologia Genética, de forma ética, com abordagem biopsicossocial do processo saúde-adoecimento, integrando ações de prevenção, promoção, proteção, recuperação e educação em saúde buscando alcançar os melhores resultados clínicos.


*PAPEIS E RESPONSABILIDADES*


  • Fornecer atendimento médico especializado em Oncologista Genético de forma remota, através de consultas e avaliações realizadas por meio de plataformas digitais de comunicação.


  • Experiência e conhecimento para o diagnóstico, tratamento e acompanhamento de pacientes com doenças e distúrbios oncológicos.


  • Realizar consultas em Telemedicina sendo capaz de: conduzir anmneses virtuais para coletar queixas e histórico médico, realizar exame clínico e avaliações à distância, interpretar resultados de exames laboratoriais e de imagem, elaborar diagnósticos precisos, propor medidas terapêuticas e orientações de cuidado, reconhecer sinais de gravidade em Nefrologia e critérios para encaminhar ao atendimento presencial.


  • Habilidade em conduzir entrevistas detalhadas e observar sintomas e sinais da especialidade Nefrologia através de videochamadas.


  • Atuar de forma a priorizar a prática médica centrada na pessoa.


  • Elaborar planos de tratamento individualizados, levando em consideração as necessidades específicas de cada paciente.


  • Ser hábil na prescrição de medicamentos adequados para tratar doenças de ordem Oncologista Genética.


  • Monitorar o progresso dos pacientes ao longo do tratamento em telemedicina.


  • Realizar ajustes no plano de tratamento, conforme necessário, com base na resposta do paciente ao tratamento.


  • Desenvolver atividades integrais de saúde, incorporando prevenção e promoção de saúde para dar as respostas mais adequadas às necessidades de saúde apresentadas.


  • Atender com elevado grau de qualidade, sendo resolutivo na grande maioria das orientações acerca de problemas de saúde em Oncologista Genética.


  • Considerar os valores e preferências pessoais do paciente conjuntamente às melhores evidências científicas e à experiência de manejo clínico para efetivamente promover a melhor prática clínica e os melhores desfechos em saúde para cada indivíduo.


  • Exercer uso racional de recursos em saúde visando a segurança do paciente e a prevenção quaternária, evitando sobrediagnóstico e sobretratamento, que expõe os indivíduos a maiores riscos do que benefícios em saúde.

As a Senior Backend Engineer , you’ll be designing and architecting scalable solutions , creating robust APIs, and building new microservices from the ground up —while also improving and optimizing our existing systems. This isn’t just another engineering role. We’re solving real, painful inefficiencies in the insurance space – problems so frustrating that prospects have nearly teared up during sales calls, realizing how much time and effort we could save them. What we’re building isn’t just an upgrade – it’s a fundamental shift in how agencies operate .


What You’ll Do:

  • Architect and develop scalable TypeScript microservices powering XILO’s platform.

  • AI Agents – Automating complex decision-making and workflows
  • OCR & Document Processing – Extracting, structuring, and analyzing key insights from insurance documents

What we’re looking for

  • 7+ years of backend development experience, with a strong foundation in TypeScript and JavaScript.

Why Join XILO?

  • A great tech startup – Small, fast-moving, and driven by real impact
  • Endless career growth – Help shape the team, tech, and company as we scale

title: Pessoa Engenheira de Dados- IA
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Pessoa Engenheira de Dados- IA em salvador. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

Esta função é estratégica para nossas soluções de marketing orientadas a dados. Buscamos alguém que combine domínio técnico em engenharia de dados com afinidade real por inteligência artificial e experiência prática com Databricks.


Principais Atribuições


  • Desenvolve e mantém pipelines de dados em Databricks, usando PySpark e Delta Lake para ingestão, transformação e disponibilização de dados em escala.
  • Constrói e sustenta fluxos ETL/ELT robustos, com foco em qualidade, rastreabilidade e performance.
  • Aplica conceitos de IA e Machine Learning no contexto de dados de marketing, colaborando com times de ciência de dados na preparação e feature engineering de datasets.
  • Escreve SQL e código Python com qualidade de produção, incluindo testes unitários e revisão técnica.
  • Contribui para arquiteturas de Data Lakehouse, incluindo organização de camadas (Bronze/Silver/Gold) e governança de dados.
  • Participa de revisões de projeto e código, propondo melhorias técnicas com consistência.


Requisitos e Qualificações


  • Experiência sólida com Databricks (notebooks, clusters, Jobs, Unity Catalog).
  • Domínio de SQL e Python para manipulação e transformação de dados.
  • Conhecimento em PySpark e Delta Lake.
  • Experiência com ferramentas e conceitos de ETL/ELT.
  • Familiaridade com práticas de MLOps ou integração de modelos de IA em pipelines de dados.
  • Entendimento de infraestrutura de dados: armazenamento em nuvem, orquestração de jobs e controle de versão.
  • Afinidade com metodologias de desenvolvimento ágil e boas práticas de engenharia de software.


Diferencial


  • Experiência com plataformas de nuvem (Azure, AWS ou GCP) integradas ao Databricks.
  • Conhecimento em LLMs, embeddings ou pipelines de dados para aplicações generativas.
  • Conhecimento em espanhol.



O que você vai encontrar por aqui:

  • Plano de saúde e Odontológico Sulamérica extensivo a dependentes
  • Seguro de vida
  • VR ou VA
  • Auxílio home office
  • Auxílio Creche (para filhos até 5 anos e 11 meses);
  • Plataforma de Aprendizagem eLearning (Dentsu university)
  • Oportunidade de desenvolvimento de Carreira
  • Parceria para desenvolvimento de idiomas, especialização, pós-graduação e MBA
  • Programas de desenvolvimento local e Global
  • Day Off de Aniversário;



Sobre a dentsu internacional

Parte da dentsu, dentsu internacional com sede em Londres, opera em mais de 145 mercados no mundo inteiro com mais de 48.000 colaboradores. Ajudamos nossos clientes a conquistar, manter e fazer crescer seus consumidores e alcançar um progresso significativo para os seus negócios. Com os melhores serviços e soluções em mídia, CXM, e criatividade.


Trabalhando conosco

Juntando-se à dentsu international, você se juntará a um grupo de 48.000 pessoas. Será uma oportunidade de produzir trabalho orientado para a construção da sua carreira. Ao longo do caminho, você se unirá a colegas inspiradores e encontrará uma riqueza de clientes, culturas e experiências. Oferecemos desafios motivadores, experiências memoráveis e oportunidades para moldar seu futuro.


Inclusão e Diversidade

Estamos orgulhosos de ser diferente e isso começa com nossa gente. Acreditamos na igualdade de oportunidades para todos e não definimos as pessoas por sua raça, sexo, orientação sexual, idade ou deficiência. A individualidade é o que nos torna grandes, queremos que cada um traga seu eu completo para o trabalho e crie algo surpreendente. É com isso que nos preocupamos. Portanto, quer você se junte a nós, quer procure mudar para uma parte diferente do negócio, nós trabalhamos duro para garantir a criação de oportunidades iguais para todos.


Nossas 8 maneiras


Com mais de 48.000 especialistas dedicados em 145 mercados, nossas '8 maneiras' formam e guiam a maneira como fazemos as coisas aqui, de modo que, juntos, podemos alcançar o 'nunca antes' para nossos clientes, para a sociedade e uns para os outros.

Formamos equipes sem limites.

Todos nós lideramos.

Tornamos isso realidade.

Escolhemos a emoção.

title: Desenvolvedor(a) Fullstack Sênior (Node e React)
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Desenvolvedor(a) Fullstack Sênior (Node e React) em salvador. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

Olá, somos a SuperFrete :)


Queremos ser a maior e mais amada rede de logística digital, quer fazer parte disso?


Somos uma startup que atua no segmento do varejo e logística, apoiando os pequenos e médios empreendedores a se tornarem mais competitivos no mercado e a alavancarem suas vendas. Por isso, buscamos um Super Desenvolvedor(a) Fullstack Sênior atuando de forma com Node e React, que se identifique com o nosso propósito, que tenha muita energia para somar no time de Tecnologia e que queira crescer (muito!) com a gente.


Responsabilidades:

  • Desenvolver, manter e evoluir aplicações backend e frontend utilizando Node.js, TypeScript, JavaScript e React
  • Participar da definição e evolução da arquitetura, propondo soluções escaláveis, performáticas e sustentáveis;
  • Atuar no desenvolvimento e manutenção de aplicações web e mobile;
  • Integrar aplicações com serviços de nuvem, bancos de dados e iniciativas de DevOps, garantindo escalabilidade e confiabilidade;
  • Participar de code reviews e promover boas práticas, qualidade e consistência do código;
  • Realizar análises e viabilidades técnicas, avaliando impactos, complexidade, aderência arquitetural e estratégias de implementação para apoiar decisões e priorizações do negócio;
  • Explorar, testar e propor o uso de soluções e ferramentas baseadas em IA que contribuam para ganho de produtividade, melhoria da experiência do usuário e evolução dos produtos;
  • Trabalhar em conjunto com times multidisciplinares para resolver problemas complexos e construir soluções alinhadas ao negócio.


Requisitos:

  • Sólida experiência com desenvolvimento backend e frontend utilizando Node.js, TypeScript, JavaScript e React;
  • Experiência com gerenciamento de estado utilizando Redux e/ou Zustand;
  • Experiência com serviços de nuvem como Firebase, AWS, GCloud ou similares;
  • Familiaridade com bancos de dados relacionais e não relacionais, como Postgres e MongoDB;
  • Experiência com testes automatizados e práticas de qualidade de software;
  • Conhecimento em arquitetura de software, APIs, padrões de desenvolvimento e boas práticas (Clean Code/Clean Architecture);
  • Experiência com práticas de DevOps, automação e pipelines CI/CD;
  • Vivência com arquitetura orientada a serviços e/ou ambientes serverless;
  • Experiência com Git e metodologias ágeis (Scrum/Kanban);
  • Interesse, familiaridade ou experiência no uso de recursos de Inteligência Artificial aplicados ao desenvolvimento, automação e produtividade, utilizando ferramentas como Cursor, Copilot, Claude, ChatGPT ou similares, além de iniciativas de aprendizado contínuo no tema;
  • Capacidade de resolver problemas complexos e construir soluções escaláveis.


Diferenciais:

  • Vivência em construção, evolução e definição de arquitetura técnica;
  • Experiência ou potencial para atuar como referência técnica ou evoluir para uma posição de Tech Lead, apoiando decisões técnicas, mentoria e desenvolvimento do time;
  • Experiência com tecnologias de desenvolvimento mobile ou híbrido, como React Native, Capacitor, Cordova ou Ionic;
  • Experiência em ambientes de startup e crescimento acelerado.


O que você pode esperar dos Supers?

  • Uma cultura de muita confiança, colaboração, focada em resultados, com muita autonomia e transparência;
  • Buscamos excelência em tudo o que fazemos, por isso estamos sempre aprendendo;
  • Temos vontade de construir junto, fazer a diferença e gerar impacto.


O que oferecemos:

title: Video Creator
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Video Creator em salvador. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

Job Title: Video Creator / Creative Editor

Location: 100% Remote

Type: Contract

Compensation: Retainer that reflects experience, seniority and skill level, + bonuses.

Required Assessment:

───────────────────────────────

916 Studios is a premium creative production company producing social-first content for brands, creators, agencies, and public companies. Our clients range from fast-scaling consumer brands to publicly listed companies, with projects including work for Google, Oracle and TikTok.

───────────────────────────────

THE ROLE:

We're looking for a multi-disciplinary Video Creator / Creative Editor who doesn’t wait to be told that something ‘could be better’.

Video Creators produce high-performance content for social media, website and beyond, blending strategy, editing, motion, sound, and narrative into media that drives results, (not just views).

───────────────────────────────

WHAT YOU'LL DO:

  • Edit premium short & long-form content for TikTok, Instagram, YouTube, , and X
  • Own projects end-to-end, from brief to final delivery
  • Act as your own creative director, i.e. source, create, or generate every asset if needed, including: graphics, motion, sound, etc, to cohesively serve the story
  • Build engaging hooks, retention and pacing
  • Adapt creative styles intelligently to different brands and audiences
  • Deliver strong first drafts

───────────────────────────────

COMPLETE THE ASSESSMENT AND APPLY IF YOU HAVE:

  • 5+ years of professional editing experience
  • A portfolio of social-first content that proves viewer-retention with links to work currently live on social media
  • Advanced Premiere Pro + working After Effects so that you can build from scratch, (not reliant on templates)
  • A strong sense of storytelling, with the ability to independently select and organise footage into a coherent, engaging narrative even without a provided script
  • The ability to work efficiently under pressure and at speed without compromising quality
  • Strong sense for design, photo editing, and branding
  • A strong sound design, colour grading, and audio mixing ability
  • A deep understanding of hooks, pacing, retention, and platform-native editing
  • Clean workflow habits: methodical, organised, no missed deadlines and excellent communication.

───────────────────────────────

WHAT SUCCESS LOOKS LIKE:

  • You consistently deliver high-quality edits with meticulous attention to detail
  • Your first cuts are robust and require minimal revision (if any!)
  • You actively look for ways to improve content without being asked
  • You anticipate roadblocks and resolve issues independently before escalating
  • You meet deadlines consistently and flag potential delays early
  • You bring fresh ideas, formats, and techniques to every project

───────────────────────────────

WHY JOIN US:

  • 100% remote, flexible working
  • Full creative ownership from day one without micromanagement
  • International brands and creator campaigns
  • Performance bonuses + genuine path to a core creative role
  • Upskilling with AI workflows and content systems

───────────────────────────────

HOW TO APPLY:

  • Complete the required creative assessment first:
  • Include your portfolio, CV, and a 2–4 sentence cover note.
  • IMPORTANT: Applications without a completed assessment will not be considered.

title: Executivo(a) Sênior de Vendas
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Executivo(a) Sênior de Vendas em salvador. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

Sobre a Empresa


Estamos em busca de um(a) profissional com forte perfil comercial para integrar nossa unidade de Interventional Systems no Brasil. Esta posição estratégica terá base em Salvador (BA), com atuação nas regiões Nordeste e Norte, sendo responsável pelo desenvolvimento e expansão do território.



Sobre a Posição

O(a) profissional será responsável pela gestão de contas, abertura de novos centros implantadores e crescimento do market share, atuando como principal ponto de relacionamento com médicos, hospitais e líderes de opinião.



Responsabilidades


  • Gerenciar e expandir o território designado
  • Desenvolver novas contas e oportunidades de negócio
  • Fortalecer relacionamento com médicos, hospitais e KOLs
  • Promover, vender e oferecer suporte técnico aos produtos
  • Acompanhar procedimentos médicos e demonstrar diferenciais técnicos
  • Apoiar negociações, contratos e processos de licitação
  • Trabalhar em conjunto com especialistas de produto em treinamentos
  • Garantir padronização e presença dos produtos no mercado
  • Representar a empresa em eventos e congressos


Qualificações


  • Ensino superior completo (Enfermagem, Engenharia, Ciências da Saúde, Marketing ou áreas correlatas)
  • Mínimo de 5 anos de experiência em vendas no mercado médico
  • Conhecimento em hemodinâmica, cath lab e rotinas hospitalares
  • Experiência com licitações públicas será um diferencial
  • Inglês avançado desejável


Habilidades Necessárias


  • Perfil “hunter”, proativo, orientado a resultados e com forte atuação em campo
  • Experiência sólida em vendas de dispositivos médicos (preferencialmente em hemodinâmica)
  • Vivência em desenvolvimento de território e abertura de contas
  • Excelente capacidade de relacionamento e influência
  • Autonomia, organização e visão estratégica
  • Experiência com licitações públicas será um diferencial
  • Disponibilidade para viagens: aproximadamente 50% do tempo



Por que se juntar à Terumo?

Na Terumo, trabalhamos com propósito: contribuir para a sociedade por meio da saúde. Esta é uma oportunidade de atuar em um desafio estratégico, com autonomia e impacto real na vida de pacientes, ampliando o acesso a soluções inovadoras em regiões com grande potencial de crescimento.



Se você busca crescimento, desafio e propósito, venha fazer parte do nosso time!

Sobre a ília

Somos especialistas em tecnologia, dados e design, impulsionando a transformação digital de grandes players do mercado há mais de 10 anos, nos setores financeiro, seguros e mobilidade. Com mais de 450 profissionais, estamos presentes no Brasil e Europa, atendendo aos mercados da América Latina, Europa e América do Norte, desenvolvendo produtos digitais de alta qualidade e com foco em resultados de negócios. Certificada pelo 7° ano consecutivo como Great Place to work aqui na ília acreditamos que pessoas mudam o mundo, e investimos nelas. Nossas awesome deliveries são feitas de pessoas para pessoas, afinal awesome people make awesome deliveries!

  • Apoiar times de Marketing, CRM, BI e Tecnologia na adoção do Data Cloud.

Modelagem de dados

Integração de dados (ETL/ELT, APIs)

Identidade e unificação de dados

title: Business Development Representative - Brazil
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Business Development Representative - Brazil em salvador. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

WHO ARE WE?

We are a bunch of super enthusiastic, passionate, and highly driven people, working to achieve a common goal! We believe that work and the workplace should be joyful and always buzzing with energy!

CloudSEK, one of India’s most trusted Cyber security product companies, is on a mission to build the world’s fastest and most reliable AI technology that identifies and resolves digital threats in real-time. The central proposition is leveraging Artificial Intelligence and Machine Learning to create a quick and reliable analysis and alert system that provides rapid detection across multiple internet sources, precise threat analysis, and prompt resolution with minimal human intervention.

Founded in 2015, headquartered at Singapore, we are proud to say that we’ve grown at a frenetic pace and have been able to achieve some accolades along the way, including:

CloudSEK’s Product Suite:

  • CloudSEK XVigil constantly maps a customer’s digital assets, identifies threats and enriches them with cyber intelligence, and then provides workflows to manage and remediate all identified threats including takedown support.
  • A powerful Attack Surface Monitoring tool that gives visibility and intelligence on customers’ attack surfaces. CloudSEK's BeVigil uses a combination of Mobile, Web, Network and Encryption Scanners to map and protect known and unknown assets.
  • CloudSEK’s Contextual AI SVigil identifies software supply chain risks by monitoring Software, Cloud Services, and third-party dependencies.


Key Milestones:

  • 2016 : Launched our first product.
  • 2018 : Secured Pre-series A funding.
  • 2019 : Expanded operations to India, Southeast Asia, and the Americas.
  • 2020 : Won the NASSCOM-DSCI Excellence Award for Security Product Company of the Year.
  • 2021 : Raised $7M in Series A funding led by MassMutual Ventures.
  • Awards & Recognition : Won NetApp Excellerator's \"Best Growth Strategy Award,\" CloudSEK XVigil joined NVIDIA Inception Program, and won the NASSCOM Emerge 50 Cybersecurity Award.
  • 2025 : Secured $19 million in funding led by Tenacity Ventures, Commvault.


About the Role:

As a Business Development Representative (BDR), you’ll be at the forefront of CloudSEK’s growth. You’ll identify and qualify high-quality leads, nurture relationships with potential clients, and ultimately contribute to our mission of becoming Asia’s leading cybersecurity company.


Requirements:

  • 1-3 years of experience as an SDR/BDR in a SaaS company. If you have worked in the cybersecurity space, that would be awesome! If not, no worries, most of us are from different industries :)
  • We have a proven track record of successfully generating good quality leads, especially C-level.
  • Strong communication and interpersonal skills, both verbal and written.
  • Excellent phone and email etiquette.
  • Know your way around CRM tools (Salesforce, HubSpot), and data providers (Apollo, Lusha). If not, the team is more than happy to work with you.
  • Self-motivated, results-oriented, and a team player.
  • You are competitive, but with yourself. You set your benchmarks and break them every single quarter.


Key Responsibilities:

  • Prospecting: We will utilize various channels ( Sales Navigator, Lusha, Apollo) to identify the right accounts and contacts within our target market.
  • Lead qualification : Assess and qualify leads based on specific criteria, ensuring they align with our ideal customer profile.
  • Lead generation: Multi-channel outreach (cold calling, email, , looms..etc) to reach out to potential clients and book introductory meetings with the sales team
  • Relationship building: Build rapport and establish trust with prospects, positioning yourself as a trusted advisor.
  • Pipeline development: Contribute to the sales pipeline by consistently generating qualified leads and opportunities.
  • CRM hygiene: Maintain accurate and up-to-date records of all activities and interactions within our CRM system.
  • Collaboration: Work closely with the sales team to ensure a smooth handover of qualified leads and opportunities.
  • Continuous Learning: Stay informed about industry trends, product updates, and competitive landscapes to enhance your outreach.
  • Language: Fluency in English

title: Sr. Compliance OnBoarding Specialist
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Sr. Compliance OnBoarding Specialist em salvador. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

About the Role


We are looking for a highly motivated and detail-oriented Senior Compliance Onboarding Specialist to join our growing team at Velafi. In this role, you will be instrumental in managing and enhancing the onboarding and KYC (Know Your Customer) processes for our clients across multiple jurisdictions, with a strong focus on Brazil and Latin America.


You will collaborate closely with Sales, Operations, and Compliance teams to design efficient, scalable onboarding frameworks that deliver a seamless customer experience while maintaining strict adherence to regulatory requirements. This position is ideal for someone who thrives in a fast-paced fintech environment and is passionate about balancing compliance excellence with business enablement.


Key Responsibilities


  • Contribute to the development, implementation, and continuous improvement of onboarding controls, policies, and procedures to ensure efficiency, scalability, and regulatory compliance.
  • Act as the subject matter expert for onboarding clients operating in Brazil, ensuring alignment with Brazilian local AML/CTF regulations and industry best practices.
  • Perform detailed reviews and analysis of B2B customer documentation, including Customer Risk Assessments and Customer Due Diligence to support informed onboarding decisions.
  • Partner with Sales, Operations, and other internal stakeholders to provide clear guidance on compliance requirements, enabling smooth client onboarding and expansion into new markets. Advise internal teams on AML risks and regulatory considerations when entering new industries or geographic regions.
  • Conduct background checks, adverse media screenings, and ongoing monitoring of clients and prospects to identify and mitigate potential risks.
  • Support the Compliance function in applying regulatory frameworks across LATAM jurisdictions, ensuring compliant operations in Brazil matters.


What We’re Looking For


  • Bachelor’s degree in Law, Finance, Business Administration, or a related field, with a strong foundation in Compliance.
  • 3+ years of hands-on experience in Compliance, preferably within fintech, digital banking, payments, or financial services environments.
  • Strong knowledge of KYC, AML, CDD, and CRA frameworks
  • Solid understanding of Brazilian AML/CTF regulations
  • Familiarity with international regulatory standards, including BSA, USA PATRIOT Act, and OFAC
  • Ability to evaluate complex customer structures, identify risks, and make sound compliance decisions.
  • Excellent interpersonal skills with the ability to work cross-functionally and communicate complex regulatory concepts clearly.
  • Fluent in Spanish (English is a strong plus).
  • Proactive, detail-oriented, and comfortable operating in a dynamic, fast-growing environment with evolving regulatory landscapes.

title: Liquidity Partnership Manager (LATAM)
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Liquidity Partnership Manager (LATAM) em salvador. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

Role Overview

We are looking for an LP Partnership Manager to drive business development and build strong relationships with liquidity providers across key regions. This role will be instrumental in sourcing, onboarding, and managing LP partners, while working closely with the trading team to optimize liquidity, pricing, and execution.

The ideal candidate is highly connected within the local market, with a strong network of liquidity providers and a deep understanding of regional payment and banking landscapes.


Key Responsibilities

Business Development & Partnerships

  • Identify, source, and establish relationships with local and regional liquidity providers
  • Evaluate LP quality (pricing, depth, reliability, regions covered)
  • Negotiate trading terms (spreads, fees, credit lines, margin terms)


Market & Network Development

  • Leverage existing network to expand LP coverage in key regions (APAC, LATAM, Africa)
  • Maintain strong relationships with banks, payment providers, and liquidity partners
  • Stay up to date with local market dynamics, pricing trends, and competitive landscape


Execution & Collaboration

  • Work closely with traders to ensure optimal liquidity, pricing, and execution quality
  • Coordinate with internal teams to onboard LPs and ensure smooth operational setup
  • Support ongoing performance monitoring and optimization of LP relationships


Banking & Infrastructure Setup

  • Facilitate opening of bank accounts and payment rails required for LP operations
  • Identify suitable partners to support local currency flows and settlement


Requirements

  • 5 to 10 years of experience in business development, partnerships, or liquidity management
  • Strong experience in payments, FX, trading, or related financial services
  • Well connected with liquidity providers, banks, and payment partners
  • Proven ability to source and onboard LPs in local markets
  • Strong understanding of regional market structures and liquidity dynamics
  • Must have strong, deep LP network in at least one of the following regions: LATAM


Vision & Mission

  • OSL is the first SFC-licensed digital asset platform in Hong Kong and a PayFi innovator. Through stablecoin payments, cross-border settlement and global licensing, we are building the next-generation payments network. Stablecoins have become everyday money across emerging markets and are widely viewed as blockchain’s “killer app,” with industry focus shifting from token issuance to real-world consumer and enterprise payment adoption. The strongest growth lies in cross-border B2B payments, where providers embedding stablecoins into corporate settlement flows can capture significant volume and float. Long-term defensibility comes from regulatory licences, banking partners and cross-border corridors.
  • OSL holds or has acquired licences in Hong Kong, Japan, Australia, Bermuda and Indonesia, and is expanding into Europe, Brazil, Southeast Asia and Africa through acquisitions and licence applications. With OSL Pay and StableX, we embed stablecoin settlement into bank accounts and card networks, support 150+ digital assets, and provide 24/7 fiat–stablecoin conversion. As a regulated pioneer with a startup mindset, we believe the future of payments will be driven by real adoption and scalable deployment, not technology narratives. We welcome builders who are passionate about crypto and payments to join us in shaping compliant, global payment infrastructure.

title: Data Annotator
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Data Annotator em salvador. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

Who is Blueprint Technologies?

We are a technology solutions firm headquartered in Bellevue, Washington, with a strong presence across the United States and an expanding footprint across Latin America (LATAM). Our teams are united by a shared passion for solving complex problems.


At Blueprint, we use technology as a bridge between strategy and execution. Our people bring diverse perspectives, deep expertise, and real-world experience across industries to help organizations grow, transform, and innovate.


About the Role

We are seeking detail-oriented Labelers / Annotators to evaluate responses generated by AI systems across multiple languages .


This role focuses on side-by-side (SBS) evaluation of outputs from different AI models across real-world scenarios. You will play a key role in improving how AI systems understand and communicate across languages and cultures.


This is not a translation role . It is an evaluation and analysis role requiring strong judgment and attention to detail.


Language Requirement

Fluency in English + at least one of the following languages:

  • Chinese (Simplified and/or Traditional)
  • Japanese
  • Korean
  • Italian
  • German
  • French


What You’ll Work On

You will evaluate AI responses across scenarios such as:

  • General-purpose Q&A
  • Web search results
  • File-based and image-based responses
  • Image and file generation tasks
  • Single-turn and multi-turn conversations


Responsibilities

  • Perform side-by-side (SBS) comparisons of AI-generated responses
  • Evaluate outputs based on:
  • Accuracy
  • Relevance
  • Clarity
  • Instruction-following
  • Identify nuances in tone, meaning, and cultural context across languages
  • Apply detailed, scenario-specific annotation guidelines
  • Maintain consistency and high-quality evaluations


Required Qualifications

  • Professional fluency in English + at least one target language listed above
  • Prior experience with side-by-side (SBS) labeling or annotation
  • Strong analytical thinking and attention to detail
  • Ability to quickly understand and apply structured evaluation frameworks


Preferred Qualifications

  • Background in linguistics, translation, or localization
  • Experience in:
  • AI evaluation
  • Data annotation
  • Search relevance or content quality analysis


Compensation

We offer competitive compensation aligned with local markets and experience.

Estimated hourly range: R$75 – R$85 BRL

Estimated monthly equivalent (full-time): R$12,000 – R$13,600 BRL

Actual compensation will be determined based on experience, skills, and internal equity.


Training & Qualification

All new hires will complete a structured onboarding program, including:

  • Training sessions and practice exercises
  • Calibration against quality benchmarks
  • Qualification review before moving into production work


Benefits & Employment Structure

This role is hired through an Employer of Record (EOR) partner, ensuring full compliance with local labor laws and payroll requirements.

Employees receive locally compliant benefits, which may include:

  • Statutory benefits (e.g., paid leave, 13th salary where applicable)
  • Social security and healthcare contributions
  • Additional benefits aligned with local market practices


Why Blueprint?

  • Work on cutting-edge AI systems
  • Be part of a global, multilingual team
  • Build highly transferable AI evaluation skills
  • Contribute directly to improving real-world AI experiences


Equal Opportunity Employer

Blueprint Technologies is an equal opportunity employer. We consider all qualified applicants without regard to race, color, age, disability, gender identity, sexual orientation, religion, national origin, or any other protected status.

A Dimensa está no topo do jogo quando o assunto é tecnologia e infraestrutura para operações financeiras, crédito e risco, e seguros.
